en: Through the force of his convictions Daraman managed to lead Gabel, the djinn's famous king, onto the path of truth and redemption. It has been insinuated that he acted purposefully to sow the seeds of disunity among the djinn race, but considering his personal integrity this seems unlikely. Whatever his motives, though, Daraman's teachings caused a bitter controversy among the djinns, and eventually a fierce civil war broke out. This did a lot to ease the situation for the humans, but Banor was clear-sighted enough to know that his race would sooner or later get involved into the conflict. It was not hard to work out for him which side to support. Under the influence of Daraman's teachings Gabel, his former enemy, openly propagated peaceful coexistence between humans and djinns. Banor accepted this offer in the name of all humans and formed an alliance with the Marid. It was only logical then that the Alliance fought side by side in the battle of Ankrahmun against the Efreet who had secretly allied with the Drefian necromancers. The victory of the Alliance was overwhelming, but it came with a heavy price. A cataclysmic firestorm unleashed by the Efreet set the whole Kha'labal ablaze, forever turning what used to be a paradise into a barren wasteland. Countless human lives were lost in the magic inferno, and the survivors found that their homes had been destroyed. Faced with a choice of slowly starving to death or leaving their native land forever, a large group of survivors followed Banor on his quest for a new home. Their exodus triggered a chain of events that eventually resulted in the cataclysmic wars of the unliving, but it was also the fateful moment when the humans' slow, but steady conquest of the whole of Tibia started. But that is a different story.
translated: A través de la fuerza de sus convicciones, Daraman logró guiar a Gabel, el famoso rey de los djinn, por el camino de la verdad y la redención. Se ha insinuado que actuó intencionadamente para sembrar las semillas de la desunión entre la raza djinn, pero considerando su integridad personal esto parece poco probable. Sin embargo, cualesquiera que fueran sus motivos, las enseñanzas de Daraman provocaron una amarga controversia entre los djinns y, finalmente, estalló una feroz guerra civil. Esto contribuyó mucho a aliviar la situación de los humanos, pero Banor fue lo suficientemente perspicaz como para saber que su raza tarde o temprano se involucraría en el conflicto. No le resultó difícil decidir a qué lado apoyar. Bajo la influencia de las enseñanzas de Daraman, Gabel, su antiguo enemigo, propagó abiertamente la coexistencia pacífica entre humanos y djinns. Banor aceptó esta oferta en nombre de todos los humanos y formó una alianza con los Marid. Era lógico entonces que la Alianza luchara lado a lado en la batalla de Ankrahmun contra los Efreet que se habían aliado secretamente con los nigromantes drefianos. La victoria de la Alianza fue abrumadora, pero tuvo un alto precio. Una cataclísmica tormenta de fuego desatada por los Efreet incendió todo Kha'labal, convirtiendo para siempre lo que solía ser un paraíso en un páramo árido. Se perdieron innumerables vidas humanas en el infierno mágico y los supervivientes descubrieron que sus hogares habían sido destruidos. Ante la opción de morir lentamente de hambre o abandonar su tierra natal para siempre, un gran grupo de supervivientes siguió a Banor en su búsqueda de un nuevo hogar. Su éxodo desencadenó una cadena de eventos que finalmente resultaron en las guerras cataclísmicas de los no vivos, pero también fue el momento fatídico en el que comenzó la lenta pero constante conquista de los humanos de todo Tibia. Pero esa es una historia diferente.

en: Thus, the great battle was won by the allied armies of the Marid and the humans. However, for the winners there was little left to feel triumphant about. The losses had been great on both sides, and the Kha'labal, that beautiful garden given to the humans by the gods, had been turned into a barren, hostile desert. Also, the destruction cause the fire had allowed many Efreet to escape, so it seemed unlikely that the war would end now. However, for the time being Malor and his troops were much too weak to pose a serious military threat, so Gabel decided to abandon pursue. Instead he ordered that his army should move northwards towards Drefia. It seemed time to settle old scores.
translated: Así, la gran batalla fue ganada por los ejércitos aliados de Marid y los humanos. Sin embargo, a los ganadores les quedaba poco por qué sentirse triunfantes. Las pérdidas habían sido cuantiosas en ambos bandos, y el Kha'labal, ese hermoso jardín regalado a los humanos por los dioses, se había convertido en un desierto árido y hostil. Además, la destrucción causada por el incendio había permitido que muchos Efreet escaparan, por lo que parecía poco probable que la guerra terminara ahora. Sin embargo, por el momento Malor y sus tropas estaban demasiado débiles para representar una amenaza militar seria, por lo que Gabel decidió abandonar la persecución. En lugar de eso, ordenó que su ejército avanzara hacia el norte, hacia Drefia. Parecía hora de ajustar viejas cuentas.

en: Warning! Only Sorcerers are allowed to pass.

Wave after wave of undead and Efreet stormed against Ankrahmun, and wave after wave broke at the huge fortifications of the ancient city. Both the Marid and the humans were well-prepared for this battle, and even though Malor's army wreaked havoc they never yielded.
translated: Ola tras ola de muertos vivientes y Efreet atacaron Ankrahmun, y ola tras ola rompieron en las enormes fortificaciones de la antigua ciudad. Tanto los Marid como los humanos estaban bien preparados para esta batalla y, aunque el ejército de Malor causó estragos, nunca cedieron.

en: We are aware that there are some ancient ruins north of Edron. Orshabaal, who is a powerful servant of the Ruthless Seven, might appear in this area to scare people away and to distract any attention.
translated: Somos conscientes de que hay algunas ruinas antiguas al norte de Edron. Orshabaal, que es un poderoso sirviente de los Ruthless Seven, podría aparecer en esta área para ahuyentar a la gente y distraer la atención.

en: We assume that the last major eruption coincided with the destruction of the Nightmare Knights. Several earlier reports of increased demonic activity overlap with eruptions, too.
translated: Suponemos que la última gran erupción coincidió con la destrucción de los Nightmare Knights. Varios informes anteriores de una mayor actividad demoníaca también se superponen con erupciones.

en: We confirm that the Ruthless Seven have occupied the place which is known as Pits of Inferno. With the help of divination, we were able to see that they channelled their dark essence to some remote place in our world for unknown reasons. We could not figure out this place, though. It cannot be emphasised enough that it is extremely important to find this place and if possible, to destroy it.
translated: Confirmamos que los Ruthless Seven han ocupado el lugar conocido como Pits of Inferno. Con la ayuda de la adivinación, pudimos ver que canalizaron su esencia oscura hacia algún lugar remoto de nuestro mundo por razones desconocidas. Sin embargo, no pudimos identificar este lugar. No se puede enfatizar lo suficiente que es extremadamente importante encontrar este lugar y, si es posible, destruirlo.

en: We have stolen the key to the large ancient temple hall under the city of Tibia. But the key is useless now, because the temple has been plundered by the humans. The temple is free, also for us, the trolls. The entrance is outside the human city.
translated: Hemos robado la llave del gran salón del antiguo templo debajo de la ciudad de Tibia. Pero la llave es inútil ahora, porque el templo ha sido saqueado por los humanos. El templo es gratis, también para nosotros, los trolls. La entrada está fuera de la ciudad humana.

en: We lost three mages in our last attempt at performing a controlled demon summoning. It is still too difficult to predict in what way the fabric of time and space is affected by the breach of the sphere, and from what we have seen the backlash of nature against demonic incursion can range from a slightly offensive odour to a sizeable explosion such as the one we saw yesterday. I am personally disappointed to observe that the elemental protection spells we put up did not work at all. Perhaps there is some truth in the reports that the unleashed energy is of purely entropical nature. We have yet to decide whether or not it makes sense to create an entropic counterspell first, but I support the idea that the loss of manpower while trying to balance the spell is manageable. It is possible, though, that this will lead to no convincing result at all due to the uncontrollable nature of the demonic realm. If this should be the case the use of entropic countermagic is the only option left.
translated: Perdimos a tres magos en nuestro último intento de realizar una invocación controlada de demonios. Todavía es demasiado difícil predecir de qué manera la estructura del tiempo y el espacio se ve afectada por la ruptura de la esfera, y por lo que hemos visto, la reacción de la naturaleza contra la incursión demoníaca puede variar desde un olor ligeramente ofensivo hasta una explosión considerable como la que vimos ayer. Personalmente, me decepciona observar que los hechizos de protección elemental que pusimos no funcionaron en absoluto. Quizás haya algo de verdad en los informes de que la energía desatada es de naturaleza puramente entrópica. Todavía tenemos que decidir si tiene sentido o no crear primero un contrahechizo entrópico, pero apoyo la idea de que la pérdida de mano de obra al intentar equilibrar el hechizo es manejable. Sin embargo, es posible que esto no conduzca a ningún resultado convincente debido a la naturaleza incontrolable del reino demoníaco. Si este fuera el caso, el uso de contramagia entrópica es la única opción que queda.

en: We offer some magic spells for Paladins.
translated: Ofrecemos algunos hechizos mágicos para Paladines.

en: We, the families of the Augur, have been living here for many generations. In the course of time, we acquired certain insights in the ways of our masters, the Yalahari. Many years ago, things used to be very different in this city. Once it was a marvel to behold, but then it started to decay slowly and steadily. This process of deterioration begun in the far past, long before our ancestors came here. At the time they were brought here by the Yalahari as helpers and workers, the city already showed signs of decline. Despite their claim of having great power, the Yalahari could do little to stop the catastrophes that should occur. Neither did they do anything to restore the damaged parts of the city. Still, it took many centuries until the city had reached the pitiful state that you can witness today.
translated: Nosotros, las familias de los Augur, hemos vivido aquí durante muchas generaciones. Con el paso del tiempo, adquirimos ciertos conocimientos sobre las costumbres de nuestros maestros, los Yalahari. Hace muchos años las cosas eran muy diferentes en esta ciudad. Una vez fue una maravilla de contemplar, pero luego comenzó a decaer lenta y constantemente. Este proceso de deterioro comenzó en un pasado lejano, mucho antes de que nuestros antepasados ​​vinieran aquí. Cuando los Yalahari los trajeron aquí como ayudantes y trabajadores, la ciudad ya mostraba signos de decadencia. A pesar de su pretensión de tener un gran poder, los Yalahari poco pudieron hacer para detener las catástrofes que deberían ocurrir. Tampoco hicieron nada para restaurar las partes dañadas de la ciudad. Aún así, pasaron muchos siglos hasta que la ciudad alcanzó el lamentable estado que puedes presenciar hoy.

en: We tracked Goshnar's daughter to the gates of Carlin but lost her within the city. Of course we got no help by the 'authorities', so I think she could hide there somewhere. It's likely that the brotherhood of bones has agents in the city that gave her shelter. We think she doesn't know her father's secrets though. Her magic tricks seemed quite ordinary to us. I can't say whether the rumour that she is pregnant is true. If so, nothing is known about the father of this child. Considering that Goshnar was allied with darkness we must fear the worst. So the search for Fermubras continues.
translated: Seguimos a la hija de Goshnar hasta las puertas de Carlin pero la perdimos dentro de la ciudad. Por supuesto, el 'authorities' no nos ayudó, así que creo que podría esconderse allí en alguna parte. Es probable que la hermandad de los huesos tenga agentes en la ciudad que le dio refugio. Sin embargo, creemos que ella no conoce los secretos de su padre. Sus trucos de magia nos parecieron bastante comunes. No puedo decir si el rumor de que está embarazada es cierto. De ser así, no se sabe nada sobre el padre de este niño. Considerando que Goshnar estaba aliado con la oscuridad debemos temer lo peor. Así que continúa la búsqueda de Fermubras.

en: Welcome to Venore City Area! All visitors, adventurers, wealthy and noble people

en: Well, I started digging. It's a tedious task, not to speak of the dirt, dust, mud and all kinds of roots in your face while you barely scrape the surface on what feels like granite. Nothing interesting so far, but such a discovery is not to be made in a day's work.
translated: Bueno, comencé a investigar. Es una tarea tediosa, por no hablar de la suciedad, el polvo, el barro y todo tipo de raíces en tu cara mientras apenas raspas la superficie de lo que parece granito. Hasta ahora no hay nada interesante, pero un descubrimiento así no se puede hacer en un día de trabajo.

en: West - To the Lighthouse of Thais

When no prayer was answered anymore and no sacrifice rewarded it became evident that the gods had indeed left the human race so that it would find a destiny of its own. But they did not leave the humans without guidance. There was Daraman, the gods' chosen prophet, who carefully prepared them for the spiritual and ethical challenges that awaited them in a world full of treachery and evil. And there was Banor, the very first human, a champion of superhuman might and life span, who taught his people how to fight on the battlefield. On his advice the pharaoh of Ankrahmun built a strong army, and it was Banor who designed the plans for Ankrahmun's famous fortifications. And soon enough the new human armies proved themselves in fierce battles against their undead and orcish enemies. Their kind paid heavy prices in these costly battles, but they learnt to accept sacrifices, and it soon become apparent that the human race was here to stay. Eventually only the fearsome djinns posed a real threat to the human race. They defeated the humans in several important battles using their fearsome magic and their skill with the scimitar. However, just when the situation appeared to be most dire Daraman, the revered human prophet, entered the scene and helped to neutralise the djinn threat in a way nobody had foreseen.
translated: Cuando ya no hubo respuesta a ninguna oración ni se recompensó ningún sacrificio, se hizo evidente que los dioses habían abandonado a la raza humana para que encontrara su propio destino. Pero no dejaron a los humanos sin guía. Estaba Daraman, el profeta elegido por los dioses, quien los preparó cuidadosamente para los desafíos espirituales y éticos que les esperaban en un mundo lleno de traición y maldad. Y estaba Banor, el primer humano, un campeón de poder y duración de vida sobrehumanos, que enseñó a su pueblo a luchar en el campo de batalla. Siguiendo su consejo, el faraón de Ankrahmun construyó un ejército fuerte, y fue Banor quien diseñó los planos de las famosas fortificaciones de Ankrahmun. Y muy pronto, los nuevos ejércitos humanos demostraron su valía en feroces batallas contra sus enemigos no-muertos y orcos. Los de su especie pagaron altos precios en estas costosas batallas, pero aprendieron a aceptar sacrificios y pronto se hizo evidente que la raza humana había llegado para quedarse. Al final, sólo los temibles genios representaron una amenaza real para la raza humana. Derrotaron a los humanos en varias batallas importantes utilizando su temible magia y su habilidad con la cimitarra. Sin embargo, justo cuando la situación parecía más terrible, Daraman, el venerado profeta humano, entró en escena y ayudó a neutralizar la amenaza djinn de una manera que nadie había previsto.

en: When the looming threat of the Ghostlands was discovered it was the local druids who helped to erect a barrier that warded off the undead and the ghostly inhabitants. The prominence of druidic magic in Carlin has led to somewhat restrained relations with the Sorcerers' Guild that has close ties to Thais as is evident by the funding of the Edron academy. Over the course of time the more rigid guild members of the Sorcerers' Guild withdrew from Carlin and were replaced by freelancers and freethinkers with only loose ties to the Thaian guild so that over the years a form of acceptance between the local guilds was formed. The druids continue to be part of the everyday life of Carlin and heavily influence the culture and philosophy there.
translated: Cuando se descubrió la amenaza inminente de las Tierras Fantasma, fueron los druidas locales quienes ayudaron a erigir una barrera que protegía a los no-muertos y a los habitantes fantasmales. La prominencia de la magia druídica en Carlin ha llevado a relaciones algo restringidas con Guild de los Hechiceros, que tiene estrechos vínculos con Thais, como es evidente por la financiación de la academia Edron. Con el paso del tiempo, los miembros más rígidos del gremio de Hechiceros Guild se retiraron de Carlin y fueron reemplazados por autónomos y librepensadores con vínculos débiles con el gremio tailandés, de modo que con el paso de los años se formó una forma de aceptación entre los gremios locales. Los druidas siguen siendo parte de la vida cotidiana de Carlin e influyen enormemente en la cultura y la filosofía del lugar.

en: While travelling to the lands of Thais the princess Tahmehe, who accompanied her father Uthemath on a diplomatic mission, fell in love with a young nobleman of the empire. Although it was a forbidden love it bore fruit, and seven months after Thamehe's return to the lands of her forefathers a child was born. Pharaoh Uthemath ordered that she and her newborn baby were to die in the arena. Four behemoths were let loose on her. But just before the raging monsters could put their claws on her a flying carpet swept down from the sky and rescued both the mother and her child. The Thaian nobleman - for who else would it be but him - somehow managed to evade the hails of arrows that greeted him, and so the couple managed to make their escape northwards. The pharaoh demanded that both the nobleman and his own unfaithful daughter be handed over to him, but the Thaian king claimed he had no knowledge of their whereabouts. So the trace of the traitorous daughter was lost.
translated: Mientras viajaba a las tierras de Thais la princesa Tahmehe, que acompañaba a su padre Uthemath en misión diplomática, se enamoró de un joven noble del imperio. Aunque era un amor prohibido, dio frutos y siete meses después del regreso de Thamehe a las tierras de sus antepasados ​​nació un niño. El faraón Uthemath ordenó que ella y su bebé recién nacido murieran en la arena. Cuatro gigantes se soltaron sobre ella. Pero justo antes de que los monstruos furiosos pudieran poner sus garras sobre ella, una alfombra voladora descendió del cielo y rescató tanto a la madre como a su hijo. El noble tailandés (¿quién más podría ser sino él?) de alguna manera logró evadir la lluvia de flechas que lo recibieron, y así la pareja logró escapar hacia el norte. El faraón exigió que le entregaran tanto al noble como a su propia hija infiel, pero el rey tailandés afirmó que no tenía conocimiento de su paradero. Así se perdió el rastro de la hija traidora.

... the dream master retreated to the world behind the curtains of awareness, I can't reach him, now that the last hall of dreams is lost to the forces of evil.
I sealed Goshnar's grave so no one can enter the pits without knowing our secret.
I will try to retreat to Knightwatch Tower and wait for a dreamer in possession of the key.
So we can travel on one of the dream paths to a saver place to regroup and to plan a counter-attack.
I fear we have to recruit new members and we have only little time left to train them.
I hope Taciror will not waste our last forces in a futile attack on the Ruthless Seven.
Our order has never truly recovered from the losses in our war against Goshnar and his undead hordes.
Now that our leaders and best warriors have died in the attack on the demonic forces, we don't stand a chance against our enemies.
Our only hope is to gather new forces and to recapture the chamber of dreams.
Of course I know the right method to distract Hugo long enough to get past him.
The dream master is important to teach our recruits in the old ways and in the art of dreamwalking.
We need a leader for our cause and we need him badly. Headless we will fail and fall.
It is already uncertain who took the Nightmare Chronicles out of the pits and I have no idea where they are hidden.
They are fighting about power and influence but unity is the key to success. Our whole order is centred about unity.
All our rituals and procedures rooted on unity and sharing, they can't neglect that.
translated:
... el maestro de los sueños se retiró al mundo detrás de las cortinas de la conciencia, no puedo alcanzarlo, ahora que el último salón de los sueños está perdido en manos de las fuerzas del mal.
Sellé la tumba de Goshnar para que nadie pueda entrar a los pozos sin conocer nuestro secreto.
Intentaré retirarme a Knightwatch Tower y esperar a que un soñador tenga la llave.
Así podremos viajar por uno de los caminos soñados hasta un lugar seguro para reagruparnos y planificar un contraataque.
Me temo que tendremos que reclutar nuevos miembros y nos queda poco tiempo para capacitarlos.
Espero que Taciror no desperdicie nuestras últimas fuerzas en un ataque inútil contra los Siete Despiadados.
Nuestra orden nunca se ha recuperado realmente de las pérdidas en nuestra guerra contra Goshnar y sus hordas de no-muertos.
Ahora que nuestros líderes y mejores guerreros han muerto en el ataque a las fuerzas demoníacas, no tenemos ninguna posibilidad contra nuestros enemigos.
Nuestra única esperanza es reunir nuevas fuerzas y recuperar la cámara de los sueños.
Por supuesto que conozco el método correcto para distraer a Hugo el tiempo suficiente para pasarlo.
El maestro de los sueños es importante para enseñar a nuestros reclutas las antiguas costumbres y el arte de caminar en sueños.
Necesitamos un líder para nuestra causa y lo necesitamos urgentemente. Sin cabeza fracasaremos y caeremos.
Ya no está claro quién sacó Nightmare Chronicles de los pozos y no tengo idea de dónde están escondidos.
Están peleando por el poder y la influencia, pero la unidad es la clave del éxito. Toda nuestra orden se centra en la unidad.
Todos nuestros rituales y procedimientos basados ​​en la unidad y el compartir, no pueden descuidar eso.

en:
History of the Augur, Part I

We, the families of the Augur, have been living here for many generations. In the course of time, we acquired certain insights in the ways of our masters, the Yalahari. Many years ago, things used to be very different in this city. Once it was a marvel to behold, but then it started to decay slowly and steadily. This process of deterioration begun in the far past, long before our ancestors came[ here. At the time they were brought here by the Yalahari as helpers and workers, the city already showed signs of decline. Despite their claim of having great power, the Yalahari could do little to stop the catastrophes that should occur. Neither did they do anything to restore the damaged parts of the city. Still, it took many centuries until the city had reached the pitiful state that you can witness today.

Some decades ago, a group of Augur suspected that we all were lied to by our masters. They started to look for clues that proved their assumptions, and secretly gathered parts of the puzzle one by one. For all we know, there had been indeed a powerful race called the Yalahari that built this city to distance itself from the wars of some capricious gods. So far the tales that our masters had told us, have been true. These Yalahari were served by a group of Augur such as us. They were their helpers and workers, and the Yalahari shared some of their luxuries and achievements with them. The Yalahari concentrated on research and art, and left the more manual work to their servants, who often only knew what they had to do without understanding their tasks. At one far-away point in history, the Yalahari seemingly vanished. Certain clues that our ancestors gathered, hint that they locked themselves in the city's centre and cut off all contact to their helpers. When the Augur sometime later dared to enter the inner city, the Yalahari were all gone - vanished without a trace. After getting over the initial shock, the Augur assumed the role of the Yalahari themselves. For a while they tried to get familiar with some of the secrets of their lost masters, but they were only able to understand the most basic concepts of the Yalahari's knowledge. They stuck to their usual tasks to keep the city running. Still, they were too few to keep the enormous city, of which they understood so little, in shape.

So they decided to recruit Augur on their own. This way most of our forefathers came to Yalahar. In the meanwhile, the former Augur retreated into the inner city.
translated:
Historia del Augur, Parte I

Nosotros, las familias de los Augur, hemos vivido aquí durante muchas generaciones. Con el paso del tiempo, adquirimos ciertos conocimientos sobre las costumbres de nuestros maestros, los Yalahari. Hace muchos años las cosas eran muy diferentes en esta ciudad. Una vez fue una maravilla de contemplar, pero luego comenzó a decaer lenta y constantemente. Este proceso de deterioro comenzó en un pasado lejano, mucho antes de que nuestros antepasados ​​vinieran aquí. Cuando los Yalahari los trajeron aquí como ayudantes y trabajadores, la ciudad ya mostraba signos de decadencia. A pesar de su pretensión de tener un gran poder, los Yalahari poco pudieron hacer para detener las catástrofes que deberían ocurrir. Tampoco hicieron nada para restaurar las partes dañadas de la ciudad. Aún así, pasaron muchos siglos hasta que la ciudad alcanzó el lamentable estado que puedes presenciar hoy.

Hace algunas décadas, un grupo de Augur sospechaba que nuestros amos nos mintieron a todos. Comenzaron a buscar pistas que probaran sus suposiciones y en secreto reunieron las piezas del rompecabezas, una por una. Por lo que sabemos, efectivamente hubo una raza poderosa llamada Yalahari que construyó esta ciudad para distanciarse de las guerras de algunos dioses caprichosos. Hasta ahora los cuentos que nos habían contado nuestros maestros, han sido ciertos. Estos Yalahari fueron atendidos por un grupo de Augur como nosotros. Eran sus ayudantes y trabajadores, y los Yalahari compartían con ellos algunos de sus lujos y logros. Los Yalahari se concentraban en la investigación y el arte, y dejaban el trabajo más manual a sus sirvientes, quienes a menudo sólo sabían lo que tenían que hacer sin comprender sus tareas. En un momento lejano de la historia, los Yalahari aparentemente desaparecieron. Ciertas pistas que nuestros antepasados ​​reunieron, insinúan que se encerraron en el centro de la ciudad y cortaron todo contacto con sus ayudantes. Cuando el Augur, algún tiempo después, se atrevió a entrar en el centro de la ciudad, los Yalahari ya no estaban, desaparecieron sin dejar rastro. Tras superar el shock inicial, el Augur asumió el papel de los propios Yalahari. Durante un tiempo intentaron familiarizarse con algunos de los secretos de sus maestros perdidos, pero sólo pudieron comprender los conceptos más básicos del conocimiento de los Yalahari. Se apegaron a sus tareas habituales para mantener la ciudad en funcionamiento. Aún así, eran demasiado pocos para mantener en forma la enorme ciudad, de la que entendían tan poco.

Entonces decidieron reclutar a Augur por su cuenta. De esta manera la mayoría de nuestros antepasados ​​llegaron a Yalahar. Mientras tanto, el antiguo Augur se retiró al centro de la ciudad.

en:
History of the Augur, Part II

They brought more and more people to Yalahar. Not all of them became Augur, a good part of them lived in Yalahar as ordinary citizens. At some point, the city had reached a much larger population than under the rule of the true Yalahari, and it became difficult to provide food and shelter for everyone. Time and overuse took it's toll on the city. Over the years, more and more parts of the city were lost due to ignorance, lack of resources, or catastrophes. The new Yalahari were unable to restore broken machines and devices, and their efforts to retake certain parts of the city with the help of the Augur caused only more disaster. So the new Yalahari decided to stay in the city's centre, letting the Augur care for the rest of the city as well as they could. Still, their image as Yalahari allowed them to claim supremacy and to rule over the whole city. This all did not matter too much to our ancestors. The new Yalahari were neither cruel nor overly abusive, and they still wielded the powerful weapons and armors of the true Yalahari. So they stuck to the status quo and continued to work for the Yalahari despite everything they had found out. This worked quite well although the city was still declining and great parts of it had been lost to chaos and anarchy.

Lately, though, things started to change. It is not a dramatic change but it can be recognised gradually at many places. Some of the known routines in the orders of the Yalahari have altered. There are more and more orders who have a dubious purpose. The most frightening thing is that some orders obviously hint at a person with Yalahari knowledge that had been considered as lost for centuries. The overwhelming majority of the new Yalahari still clings to their ignorant and self-centred ways, but perhaps one of them or a small group has discovered some hidden secrets of their vanished masters. It is also possible that something completely different is happening, we simply don't know. But these new orders that seem to aim at restoring order in the city have some bitter taste. They are somewhat oppressive and destructive, not in an obvious way, though. Taken together, they paint a dark picture of Yalahar's future. A future of oppression, betrayal, and a much stricter rule by the Yalahari.
translated:
Historia del Augur, Parte II

Trajeron cada vez más gente a Yalahar. No todos se convirtieron en Augur, buena parte de ellos vivían en Yalahar como ciudadanos comunes y corrientes. En algún momento, la ciudad había alcanzado una población mucho mayor que bajo el gobierno del verdadero Yalahari, y se volvió difícil proporcionar comida y refugio para todos. El tiempo y el uso excesivo pasaron factura a la ciudad. Con el paso de los años, cada vez más partes de la ciudad se fueron perdiendo por desconocimiento, falta de recursos o catástrofes. Los nuevos Yalahari no pudieron restaurar máquinas y dispositivos averiados, y sus esfuerzos por recuperar ciertas partes de la ciudad con la ayuda del Augur sólo causaron más desastre. Así que el nuevo Yalahari decidió quedarse en el centro de la ciudad, dejando que los Augur se ocuparan del resto de la ciudad lo mejor que pudieran. Aun así, su imagen de Yalahari les permitió reclamar supremacía y gobernar toda la ciudad. Todo esto no les importaba demasiado a nuestros antepasados. Los nuevos Yalahari no eran ni crueles ni demasiado abusivos, y todavía empuñaban las poderosas armas y armaduras del verdadero Yalahari. Así que se apegaron al status quo y continuaron trabajando para Yalahari a pesar de todo lo que habían descubierto. Esto funcionó bastante bien, aunque la ciudad todavía estaba en decadencia y gran parte de ella se había perdido en el caos y la anarquía.

Sin embargo, últimamente las cosas empezaron a cambiar. No es un cambio dramático pero se puede reconocer gradualmente en muchos lugares. Algunas de las rutinas conocidas en las órdenes del Yalahari han cambiado. Cada vez hay más pedidos que tienen una finalidad dudosa. Lo más aterrador es que algunas órdenes obviamente insinúan a una persona con conocimientos de Yalahari que se habían considerado perdidos durante siglos. La abrumadora mayoría de los nuevos Yalahari todavía se aferra a sus costumbres ignorantes y egocéntricas, pero tal vez uno de ellos o un pequeño grupo haya descubierto algunos secretos ocultos de sus desaparecidos maestros. También es posible que esté sucediendo algo completamente diferente, simplemente no lo sabemos. Pero estas nuevas órdenes que parecen encaminadas a restablecer el orden en la ciudad tienen un sabor amargo. Son algo opresivos y destructivos, aunque no de manera obvia. En conjunto, pintan un panorama oscuro del futuro de Yalahar. Un futuro de opresión, traición y un gobierno mucho más estricto por parte de los Yalahari.

en:
Manifest of the Yalahari, Part I

The city has been neglected for far too long. We concentrated on our research and spiritual evolution and have turned a blind eye on the needs of the people that are our subjects. We have too strongly relied on the help of the Augur who in turn did little but the same routines for many generations. We have decided it is time to take initiative. The experiment to give people too much freedom and too little guidance has to be stopped before all is lost. We have a responsibility for this city and the people living here. Only with our help, they will be able to flourish and to overcome the shadows of the past. The city can be rebuilt and restored to at least some of its former glory when we diligently work for it. It will be hard and it will take the help of determined individuals to assist us in our efforts. However, in the long run, order will be completely re-established and Yalahar will once again be the magnificent city it used to be.

Only with drastic decisions and changes, this great goal can be achieved. We will have to get through hard times and prepare for them as good as we can. Most importantly, a good city needs a solid base. For this reason we have to start at the bottom to clean things up. We have to be precise and consequent in our decisions and actions. This way we will be able to create a solid base for the city.

To some extent, we have to work like a gardener. The rotten parts have to be cut off, and the healthy parts have to be cherished. The city has to be retaken. Then order can be restored and the actual rebuilding can begin. In the end, the city will once again be a centre of prosperity and a shining light in a dark world.
translated:
Manifiesto del Yalahari, Parte I

La ciudad lleva demasiado tiempo abandonada. Nos concentramos en nuestra investigación y evolución espiritual y hemos hecho la vista gorda ante las necesidades de las personas que son nuestros súbditos. Hemos confiado demasiado en la ayuda del Augur, quien a su vez hizo poco más que las mismas rutinas durante muchas generaciones. Hemos decidido que es hora de tomar la iniciativa. Hay que detener el experimento de dar a la gente demasiada libertad y muy poca orientación antes de que todo esté perdido. Tenemos una responsabilidad con esta ciudad y la gente que vive aquí. Sólo con nuestra ayuda podrán florecer y superar las sombras del pasado. La ciudad puede ser reconstruida y restaurada para recuperar al menos parte de su antigua gloria si trabajamos diligentemente por ella. Será difícil y será necesaria la ayuda de personas decididas que nos ayuden en nuestros esfuerzos. Sin embargo, a la larga, el orden se restablecerá por completo y Yalahar volverá a ser la magnífica ciudad que solía ser.

Sólo con decisiones y cambios drásticos se podrá lograr este gran objetivo. Tendremos que superar tiempos difíciles y prepararnos para ellos lo mejor que podamos. Lo más importante es que una buena ciudad necesita una base sólida. Por esta razón tenemos que empezar desde abajo para limpiar las cosas. Tenemos que ser precisos y consecuentes en nuestras decisiones y acciones. De esta manera podremos crear una base sólida para la ciudad.

Hasta cierto punto tenemos que trabajar como jardineros. Hay que cortar las partes podridas y cuidar las partes sanas. Hay que retomar la ciudad. Entonces podrá restablecerse el orden y podrá comenzar la reconstrucción propiamente dicha. Al final, la ciudad volverá a ser un centro de prosperidad y una luz brillante en un mundo oscuro.

en:
Manifest of the Yalahari, Part II

It is obvious that such greatness comes not without sacrifices, but we will make sure to keep them to a minimum. All of our decisions serve a greater good, of course. Even if this is not always obvious, in the end things will work out and provide us all with a better life and a bright future.

Based on the ruins of our former glory, it is hard to imagine how magnificent this future will be, but we, the Yalahari, still carry the vision of what we want to accomplish in our hearts. To bring this vision to life is our greatest goal which we all work towards.

There are elements that see their power and influence waning in these days of change. They are afraid of the things to come, and in their ignorance they cling to the rotting reality they know all too well. They created their own little niches of power and influence and feel guilty for neglecting their duties, and with that also for the decay of the city. They are surely already approaching unsuspecting outsiders to poison their minds with selfish lies. For generations the Augur, once the pride of our people, have done things the same way they had known for generations, and everyone can see where it has taken Yalahar.
translated:
Manifiesto del Yalahari, Parte II

Es obvio que tal grandeza no se logra sin sacrificios, pero nos aseguraremos de mantenerlos al mínimo. Todas nuestras decisiones sirven a un bien mayor, por supuesto. Aunque esto no siempre sea obvio, al final las cosas saldrán bien y nos brindarán a todos una vida mejor y un futuro brillante.

Teniendo en cuenta las ruinas de nuestra antigua gloria, es difícil imaginar cuán magnífico será este futuro, pero nosotros, los Yalahari, todavía llevamos la visión de lo que queremos lograr en nuestros corazones. Dar vida a esta visión es nuestro mayor objetivo por el que todos trabajamos.

Hay elementos que ven menguar su poder e influencia en estos días de cambio. Tienen miedo de lo que está por venir y, en su ignorancia, se aferran a la podrida realidad que conocen muy bien. Crearon sus propios pequeños nichos de poder e influencia y se sienten culpables por descuidar sus deberes y, con ello, también por la decadencia de la ciudad. Seguramente ya se están acercando a extraños desprevenidos para envenenar sus mentes con mentiras egoístas. Durante generaciones, los Augur, que alguna vez fueron el orgullo de nuestro pueblo, han hecho las cosas de la misma manera que lo habían sabido durante generaciones, y todos pueden ver adónde ha llevado a Yalahar.

en:
Tunnelling guide
----------------
by Gromward Hammerfist

'The art of building a tunnel lies in the nature of dwarfes.' That's what my grand grand grandfather used to say. First of all I'd like to give you a small historical review of tunnelling. .....<you skip the first 1000 pages containing dwarfen tunnelling history>.

Repairing collapsed tunnels:
Equipment: Pick, tree or bricklayers kit
Before picking away the rubble you need to place a buttress otherwise the tunnel will collapse over and over again. If you don't have a matching tree at hand you could still build a brickwall to stabilize the tunnel. Good luck!

Repairing gaps:
Equipment: Wood, wooden ties, hammer, nails, metal fitting
For each missing part (on the basis of a standard rail) I recommend to use three pieces of wood. Lock them in position by at least 6 nails. For the rail itself use a saw on a piece of wood to build your wooden ties. Then place two metal fittings on them and you can make your first ride on your new rail. Congratulations!

Building a rail on lava:
I advice not to try that until you have at least 20 years experience in rail construction......<Well, seems like you don't match the premises.>

Adventuring old tunnels:
Be aware that our kind mastered the art of tunnelling. It may take you a whole life to understand the techniques that are used and it takes generations to know all the tunnels of a mine and all their exits. You even may find an exit that you never expected to.

To sum up
If you are no dwarf don't even try to think that you have a chance of mastering the art of tunnelling. If you are a dwarf I wish you good luck and don't abandon faith. There is a light at the end of the tunnel.

Yours

Gromward Hammerfist
translated:
guía de túneles
----------------
por Gromward Hammerfist

'The art of building a tunnel lies in the nature of dwarfes.' Eso es lo que solía decir mi bisabuelo. Antes que nada me gustaría haceros un pequeño repaso histórico de la construcción de túneles. .....<you skip the first 1000 pages containing dwarfen tunnelling history>.

Reparación de túneles colapsados:
Equipo: Pico, árbol o kit de albañil.
Antes de retirar los escombros es necesario colocar un contrafuerte, de lo contrario el túnel se derrumbará una y otra vez. Si no tienes un árbol a mano, aún puedes construir una pared de ladrillos para estabilizar el túnel. ¡Buena suerte!

Reparación de huecos:
Equipo: Madera, amarres de madera, martillo, clavos, herrajes de metal.
Por cada pieza que falta (sobre la base de un riel estándar) recomiendo utilizar tres piezas de madera. Asegúrelos en su posición con al menos 6 clavos. Para el riel en sí, use una sierra en un trozo de madera para construir las traviesas de madera. Luego, coloca dos herrajes metálicos sobre ellos y podrás realizar tu primer viaje en tu nuevo riel. ¡Felicidades!

Construyendo un carril sobre lava:
Te aconsejo que no lo intentes hasta que tengas al menos 20 años de experiencia en la construcción de ferrocarriles...<Well, seems like you don't match the premises.>

Aventuras en viejos túneles:
Tenga en cuenta que los de nuestra especie dominan el arte de hacer túneles. Puede que te lleve toda una vida entender las técnicas que se utilizan y se necesitan generaciones para conocer todos los túneles de una mina y todas sus salidas. Incluso puede que encuentres una salida que nunca esperabas.

para resumir
Si no eres un enano, ni siquiera intentes pensar que tienes posibilidades de dominar el arte de hacer túneles. Si eres enano te deseo mucha suerte y no abandones la fe. Hay una luz al final del túnel.

tuyo

Puño de martillo de Gromward

en:
She's pretty, isn't she? Will ship you safely to any port. Though a young landlubber such as you should \z
	consider to travel to Thais first. The travel is for free. Just once though! You have to ask for a {passage}.
translated:
Jest ładna, prawda? Wyślemy Cię bezpiecznie do dowolnego portu. Chociaż młody szczur lądowy, taki jak ty, powinieneś \z
	rozważ najpierw podróż do Thais. Podróż jest bezpłatna. Chociaż raz! Musisz poprosić o {passage}.

en: I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However I've heard that Captain Fearless from Venore sails there.
translated: Nie żegluję tam. Na tę trasę narażony jest statek widmo! Słyszałem jednak, że pływa tam Kapitan Fearless z Venore.

en: I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However I've heard that Captain Fearless from Venore sails there.
translated: Nie żegluję tam. Na tę trasę narażony jest statek widmo! Słyszałem jednak, że pływa tam Kapitan Fearless z Venore.

en: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
translated: 'Sea Goddess' jest najpiękniejszy w Oramond, zupełnie nowy model statku, elegancki, pewny i szybki. Nie ma pogody, której by nie zniosła!

en: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
translated: Znam Marvika w Thais. Kiedyś pomógł mi z czyrakiem, który miałam na... ach, to nie ma znaczenia. Ale to miły dziadek!

en: Already got enough, huh? I kind o' expected that, landlubber! Let's head for Svargrond! Ready?
translated: Masz już dość, co? W pewnym sensie się tego spodziewałem, szczur lądowy! Jedźmy do Svargrond! Gotowy?

en: Y' already wanna give up?? I should've known. I bring ya back to Svargrond, 'kay?
translated: Już chcesz się poddać? Powinienem był wiedzieć. Zabiorę cię z powrotem do Svargrond, ok?

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: As the ruby slips into the notch, the strong red of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
translated: A medida que el rubí se desliza en la muesca, el fuerte rojo de la piedra se intensifica mil veces. Tienes miedo de lastimarte los ojos y te alejas inmediatamente. El rayo parece dirigirse al centro de la meseta con asombrosa precisión.

en: As the sapphire slips into the notch, the deep blue of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
translated: Cuando el zafiro se desliza en la muesca, el azul profundo de la piedra se intensifica mil veces. Tienes miedo de lastimarte los ojos y te alejas inmediatamente. El rayo parece dirigirse al centro de la meseta con asombrosa precisión.

en: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
translated: A medida que la esmeralda se desliza en la muesca, el verde vibrante de la piedra se intensifica mil veces. Tienes miedo de lastimarte los ojos y te alejas inmediatamente. El rayo parece dirigirse al centro de la meseta con asombrosa precisión.

en: No water then? Ah drat - er, don't worry, no problem. So, from the day I received news of the discovery of Zao, I wanted to study its inhabitants, wildlife, plants and geography. ...
translated: ¿Entonces no hay agua? Ah, diablos, no te preocupes, no hay problema. Entonces, desde el día que recibí la noticia del descubrimiento de Zao, quise estudiar sus habitantes, su vida silvestre, sus plantas y su geografía. ...

en: The academy instated the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division' shortly after. I was a founding member and head of the 'Draken' research branch. ...
translated: La academia instaló el '__PH0__-Zaoan Exploration Division' poco después. Fui miembro fundador y director de la rama de investigación 'Draken'. ...

en: Well, besides being a renowned sorcerer and scholar at the magic academy in Edron, I am also the proud father of a beautiful daughter, Ivalisse. My little endeavour here must have troubled the poor thing all the time since I left. ...
translated: Bueno, además de ser un renombrado hechicero y erudito en la academia de magia de Edron, también soy el orgulloso padre de una hermosa hija, Ivalisse. Mi pequeño esfuerzo aquí debe haber preocupado a la pobre todo el tiempo desde que me fui. ...

en: Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Lil' one want to trade?
translated: Hellsteel lo es. Maldito y malvado. Peligroso para trabajar. Puedo hacer con un casco malvado. ¿Alguno quiere intercambiar?

en: I'm not sailing there. This route is afflicted by a ghost ship! However I've heard that Captain Fearless from Venore sails there.
translated: Nie żegluję tam. Na tę trasę narażony jest statek widmo! Słyszałem jednak, że pływa tam Kapitan Fearless z Venore.

en: I'm sorry, but we don't serve this route. However, I heard that Wyrdin here in Edron is looking for adventurers to go on a trip to Yalahar for him.
translated: Przykro mi, ale nie obsługujemy tej trasy. Jednakże słyszałem, że Wyrdin tutaj w Edron szuka poszukiwaczy przygód, którzy pojechaliby dla niego na wycieczkę do Yalahar.

en: These papers can tell us much about Carlin's plans in the North. We need you to enter 'Hellgate' and to retrieve the papers for us ...
translated: Dokumenty te mogą nam wiele powiedzieć o planach Carlin na Północy. Potrzebujemy, abyś wpisał 'Hellgate' i odebrał dla nas dokumenty...

en: Very good! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Now, I need a fresh dead black sheep.
translated: Bardzo dobry! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Teraz potrzebuję świeżej, martwej czarnej owcy.

en: Ten prayers for a blessed stake? Don't tell me they made you travel whole Tibia for it! Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>
translated: Dziesięć modlitw za błogosławiony palik? Nie mów mi, że kazali ci podróżować przez to całe Tibia! Słuchaj, dziecko, jeśli przyniesiesz mi drewniany kołek, pobłogosławię go dla ciebie. <chuckles>

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
Thais es una ciudad muy concurrida.

en: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
translated: ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado de qué habla la gente ese 'main'? Bueno, una vez que hayas alcanzado el nivel 8, deberías hablar con el {oracle}. Puedes elegir un {profession} después y explorar mucho más de Tibia.

en: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
translated: Los arándanos crecen en los arbustos. Son bastante comunes en Tibia. ¡Simplemente recógelos de un arbusto si necesitas un refrigerio!

en: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
translated: El gran edificio en el centro de Rookgaard. Disponen de una biblioteca, un centro de formación, un {bank} y la sala del {oracle}. {Seymour} es el profesor allí.

en: Actually, I haven't been around much yet, but I'm looking forward to exploring the city once I've finished trading {token}s.

en: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
translated: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.

en: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.
translated: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.

en: llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!

en: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...
translated: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...

en: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.
translated: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.

en: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...
translated: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...

en: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...
translated: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?

en: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!
translated: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!

en: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!
translated: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!

en:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
translated:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z

	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.

en:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
translated:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z

en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z

	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

en: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
translated: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!

en: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
translated: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!

en: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
translated: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!

en: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
translated: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.

en: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
translated: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...

en: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
translated: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.

en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
translated: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.

en: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
translated: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...

en: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
translated: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...

en: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
translated: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.

en: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
translated: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...

en: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
translated: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.

en: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
translated: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...

en: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
translated: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...

en: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
translated: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.

en: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
translated: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...

en:
Enable this option to save screenshots of the most important
moments of your Tibia career! Whenever one of the events you
have selected takes place, a screenshot will be taken
automatically.

The following events can be selected to trigger an auto screenshot:

- Level Up: Your character has reached the next level
- Skill Up: You advanced in one of your skills (e.g. Magic Level
or Sword Fighting)
- Achievement: You earned an achievement, either while
playing or upon login
- Bestiary Entry Unlocked: You unlocked new information
about a creature in the Bestiary
- Bestiary Entry Completed: You unlocked all information about
a creature in the Bestiary
- Treasure Found: You received some reward from a container
for solving a quest or a riddle
- Valuable Loot: You just found some loot which you have
marked in the Drop Tracker
- Boss Defeated: You defeated a boss monster, either alone or
together with other players, and are entitled to loot it
- Death PvE: You were just killed by some creature (PvE)
- Death PvP: You were just killed by another player (PvP)
- Player Kill: You defeated another player
- Player Killer Assist: You assisted the killing of another player
- Player Attacking: Another player just started to attack you
- Highest Damage Dealt: You dealt a new all-time high damage
on a foe. To see or reset your current all-time high, check
the Impact Analyser
- Highest Healing Done: You healed someone with a new all-
time high healing value. To see or reset your current all-time
high, check the Impact Analyser
- Low Health: You have reached a threshold of deep red
health Copy
translated:
Habilite esta opción para guardar capturas de pantalla de los más importantes
Momentos de tu carrera Tibia! Cada vez que uno de los eventos que usted
seleccionado tiene lugar, se tomará una captura de pantalla.
automáticamente.

Se pueden seleccionar los siguientes eventos para activar una captura de pantalla automática:

- Subir de nivel: tu personaje ha alcanzado el siguiente nivel.
- Skill Up: has avanzado en una de tus habilidades (por ejemplo, nivel mágico).
o lucha con espadas)
- Logro: Obtuviste un logro, ya sea mientras
jugando o al iniciar sesión
- Bestiary Entrada desbloqueada: desbloqueaste nueva información
sobre una criatura en el Bestiary
- Bestiary Entrada completada: desbloqueaste toda la información sobre
una criatura en el Bestiary
- Treasure Encontrado: Recibiste alguna recompensa de un contenedor
para resolver una misión o un acertijo
- Botín valioso: acabas de encontrar un botín que tienes.
marcado en el Drop Tracker
- Jefe derrotado: Has derrotado a un monstruo jefe, ya sea solo o
junto con otros jugadores, y tienen derecho a saquearlo
- Muerte PvE: te acaba de matar una criatura (PvE)
- Muerte PvP: otro jugador te acaba de matar (PvP)
- Muerte de jugador: derrotaste a otro jugador.
- Player Killer Assist: ayudaste a matar a otro jugador.
- Jugador atacando: otro jugador acaba de empezar a atacarte.
- Mayor daño infligido: infligiste un nuevo daño máximo histórico
sobre un enemigo. Para ver o restablecer su máximo histórico actual, consulte
el analizador de impacto
- Mayor curación realizada: sanaste a alguien con un nuevo todo-
tiempo de alto valor curativo. Para ver o restablecer tu historial actual
alto, verifique el Analizador de Impacto
- Baja salud: has alcanzado un umbral de color rojo intenso.

en: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
translated: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.

en: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
translated: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.

en: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
translated: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!

en: Actually, I haven't been around much yet, but I'm looking forward to exploring the city once I've finished trading {token}s.
translated: Actually, I haven't been around much yet, but I'm looking forward to exploring the city once I've finished trading {token}s.

en: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
translated: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.

en: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.
translated: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.

en: llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
translated: llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!

en: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...
translated: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...

en: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.
translated: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.

en: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...
translated: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...

en: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...
translated: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?

en: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!
translated: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!

en: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!
translated: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!

en:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
translated:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.

en:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
translated:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.

en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
translated:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

en: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
translated: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!

en: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
translated: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!

en: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
translated: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!

en: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
translated: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.

en: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
translated: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...

en: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
translated: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.

en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
translated: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.

en: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
translated: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...

en: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
translated: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...

en: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
translated: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.

en: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
translated: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...

en: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
translated: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.

en: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
translated: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...

en: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
translated: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...

en: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
translated: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.

en: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
translated: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated: Hay cinco bendiciones disponibles en cinco lugares sagrados: el escudo {spiritual}, la chispa del {phoenix}, el {embrace} de Tibia, el fuego del {suns} y la sabiduría de {solitude}. Además, puedes recibir el {twist of fate} aquí.

translated: Veo que recibiste el escudo espiritual en el templo de flores blancas al sur de Thais.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Puedo sentir que los druidas al norte de Carlin te han brindado el Abrazo de Tibia.

en: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
translated: Puedo ver que recibiste la bendición de los dos soles en la torre del sol cerca de Ab'Dendriel.
