en: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
translated: He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.

en: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
translated: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.

en: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
translated: Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!

en: Actually, I haven't been around much yet, but I'm looking forward to exploring the city once I've finished trading {token}s.
translated: Actually, I haven't been around much yet, but I'm looking forward to exploring the city once I've finished trading {token}s.

en: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.
translated: We work as hard we can, my master! Wait, I haven't seen you here before. You were sent by the Corym Ratter, I see. He misses the courage to visit us and find the reason for {decreasing resources}? He's the coward I have expected.

en: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.
translated: Ohh, why didn't you tell me before? Sure you get some holy water if it's for Amanda! Here you are.

en: llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
translated: llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!

en: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...
translated: First we will test your strength and endurance. You'll have to face one of the most experienced Mooh'Tah masters. As you don't stand a chance to beat such an opponent, your test will be simply to survive. ...

en: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.
translated: Here is a reward. It's a strange tome that we've found in the lizard ruins. Maybe it is of some value for you or your allies.

en: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...
translated: We can't send a Mooh'Tah master on such a trivial assignment, neither can we use orcs for an infiltration mission. ...

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...

en: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...
translated: The trolls living west of our city have become quite a nuisance lately. Not that they are really dangerous to us, but still, we must show them that there's a line they shouldn't cross. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?

en: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!
translated: I'm pleased with your eagerness. To help you find the trolls' den, I mark both the entrance to the passage and their lair on your map. To reach your goal, you have to kill the normal brown trolls, but troll champions count too. Good luck!

en: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!
translated: Very good job, |PLAYERNAME|. You've been a great help. Here's your reward!

en:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
translated:
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ... \z
	Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ... \z
	So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.

en:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
translated:
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ... \z
	The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ... \z
	We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.

en:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z
	Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ... \z
	Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ... \z
	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
translated:
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ... \z

	If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ... \z
	However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.

en: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
translated: Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!

en: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
translated: I'm sorry honey, but I can't lend you gold. Earn it yourself by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!

en: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
translated: I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!

en: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
translated: Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.

en: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
translated: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...

en: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
translated: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.

en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
translated: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.

en: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
translated: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...

en: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
translated: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...

en: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
translated: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.

en: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
translated: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...

en: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
translated: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.

en: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
translated: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...

en: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
translated: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...

en: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
translated: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.

en: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
translated: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: Jestem pod wrażeniem Twojego zaangażowania i odwagi. Nie mogę jednak pokazać dokładnej lokalizacji Cyklopolis na mapie. To jest gdzieś na północ od miasta Edron. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: Zawsze szukamy poszukiwaczy przygód, którzy pomogliby nam zdziesiątkować liczbę cyklopów. Czy pomożesz miastu Edron, zabijając 500 z nich?

en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
translated: Jak zapewne wiesz, sprzedaję wytrychy, ale obawiam się, że jeśli nie będziesz miał wielkiego szczęścia, nie uda ci się złamać tego drogiego arcydzieła zamka. Jednak zdobądź nam tę rybę, nieważne jak.

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Rycerz z Guardii potrzebował klucza Chayenne. Jego przyjaciel upuścił przedmiot na podłogę, mając nadzieję, że nikt tego nie zobaczy. Ale w tym samym momencie na ich drodze stanął mężczyzna i wszystkie marzenia rycerza zniknęły.

en: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
translated: Myślisz, że to tylko gra? Nie boisz się płomienia smoka? Jeśli jesteś odważny i bystry, jeśli nie odstąpisz od walki, być może zechcesz dziś wieczorem usłyszeć opowieść o samotnym rycerzu Guardii.

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Rycerz z Guardii potrzebował klucza Chayenne. Jego przyjaciel upuścił przedmiot na podłogę, mając nadzieję, że nikt tego nie zobaczy. Ale w tym samym momencie na ich drodze stanął mężczyzna i wszystkie marzenia rycerza zniknęły.

en: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
translated: W kanałach Rookgaard roiło się nie mniej niż sto wrzeszczących szczurów. Brodząc w błocie i zalani krwią, dwóch młodych mężczyzn walczyło ramię w ramię. Do końca Trimery; rycerz i przyjaciel.

en:
I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
translated:
Jestem przywódcą Kuridai i Az'irela Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Ludzie nazwaliby go {sheriff}, katem lub mścicielem.

en: Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
translated: Dobry. Pęknięta rura i generator kawałki, wydobywa się dym. Tak ich rozpoznajesz. Zobacz, jak możesz je naprawić za pomocą rąk. Trzeba naprawić około dwudziestu z nich. Zgłoś się do mnie lub Jacoba

en: Our relations with Thais can be called strained at best. Therefore, it's not really astounding that the Thaian financed Edron's academy but refuse to share some knowledge with our druids ..
translated: Nasze relacje z Thais można co najwyżej nazwać napiętymi. Dlatego nie jest tak naprawdę zdumiewające, że Tajlandia finansowała akademię Edron, ale nie chciała dzielić się wiedzą z naszymi druidami..

en: It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
translated: To tylko kolejna tajska marionetka. Mimo to jest to wystarczająco odległe, aby pewnego dnia mieć spore szanse na pozbycie się ucisku Thais.

en: We don't really know how to destroy it but we suppose it may work if you reflect the invisible power of the ball. The beam should be adjusted to Ab'Dendriel. Take this mirror and give it a try. Good luck.

en: I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.

en: But the vision of a Kilmareshian seer is no proof they will ever accept in Rathleton. And without proof we can't banish the {Ambassador}, this would cause major diplomatic fallout or even a war. I can't risk that. ...
translated: Ale wizja widzącego z Kilmareshu nie jest dowodem, który kiedykolwiek zaakceptują w Rathleton. A bez dowodu nie możemy wygnać {Ambassador}, spowodowałoby to poważne konflikty dyplomatyczne, a nawet wojnę. Nie mogę tego ryzykować. ...

en: I don't know whether you are experienced in such things. If not, you could ask somebody who is. But I'm not sure where in Issavi you should look to hire a thief.
translated: Nie wiem, czy masz doświadczenie w takich sprawach. Jeśli nie, możesz zapytać kogoś, kto jest. Ale nie jestem pewien, gdzie w Issavi powinieneś zatrudnić złodzieja.

en: From all we know the lamp is still in the Orc King's possession! Therefore I want to ask you to enter thewell guarded halls over at Ulderek's Rock and find the lamp. ...
translated: Z tego, co wiemy, lampa nadal jest w posiadaniu Króla Orków! Dlatego chcę cię poprosić, abyś wszedł do dobrze strzeżonych sal przy Skale Uldereka i znalazł lampę. ...

en:
If you select Frames or Corners, your loot will be marked with 
different colours in loot messages, containers and the Bestiary.

The colour depends on the loot value, which can be determined in
 the Items Cyclopedia, either using the NPC buy value, the average
 Market price or your own preferred value.
translated:
Si seleccionas Marcos o Esquinas, tu botín se marcará con
Diferentes colores en mensajes de botín, contenedores y el Bestiary.

El color depende del valor del botín, que se puede determinar en
 los Artículos Cyclopedia, ya sea usando el valor de compra de NPC, el promedio
 Precio Market o su propio valor preferido.

en: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
translated: Lo llamamos Feyrist y es un lugar secreto y escondido. Sólo unos pocos mortales obtienen permiso para entrar. Hace mucho tiempo, aprendimos a ocultar nuestro reino del mundo exterior. Sólo si te ganas nuestra confianza te diré cómo llegar a ella.

en:
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ... \z
	We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
translated:
Algunos nos llaman espíritus de la naturaleza o peri, pero nosotros preferimos el término fae. La mayoría de nosotros somos bastante solitarios y vivimos vidas pacíficas en nuestro reino secreto. Sólo lo dejamos para proteger nuestro hogar. ...\z
	Tendemos a ser reservados sobre nuestra verdadera naturaleza, pero supongo que una vez hubo un sabio élfico que visitó nuestro reino y puso por escrito sus experiencias. Puede que haya un libro sobre las hadas en la biblioteca de Ab'Dendriel.

en: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
translated: Así que recibe mi oración: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Ahora, lleva tu apuesta a Kasmir en Darashia para la siguiente línea de la oración. Le informaré qué hacer.

en: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
translated: Deberías visitar Kasmir en Darashia ahora, hija mía.

en: Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
translated: Tu misión aquí en Tibia es ser educado y amigable. ¡Los dioses te recompensarán, lo prometo!

en: What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
translated: ¡Qué hermoso palacio! Los Kilmareshians son arquitectos muy hábiles.

en: The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
translated: El nuevo tratado de amistad y comercio con Kilmaresh es de suma importancia.

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Ojalá pudiera comer salmón ahora mismo... mejor preparado al estilo Liberty Bay... delicioso.

en: I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
translated: Estoy tratando de explorar cada lugar de Tibia y algún día lo habré visto todo.

en: If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
translated: Si viajas a Thais, deberías visitar el maravilloso castillo que hay allí.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: ¿Cuál era esa palabra de nuevo en idioma orco... hmm?

en: I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
translated: Hablo algunas palabras orcas, aunque no muchas, solo algunas palabras básicas como '{yes}' y '{no}'.

en: It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: Es 'mok' en orco. Te cuento más si me traes un poco de {food}.

en: In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
translated: En orco eso es 'burp'. Te cuento más si me traes un poco de {food}.

en: Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
translated: ¡Sí! Si me das salmón te diré otra palabra orca. ¿Bueno?

en: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
translated: Ojalá pudiera comer salmón ahora mismo... mejor preparado al estilo Liberty Bay... delicioso.

en: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
translated: ¿Cuál era esa palabra de nuevo en idioma orco... hmm?

en: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
translated: Ahoi, joven |PLAYERNAME| y bienvenido a Nordic Tibia Ferries. Si necesitas un {passage}, házmelo saber.

en: Well, a while ago powerful magic devices were used all around Tibia. These are chargeable compasses. There was but one problem: they offered the possibility to make people rich in a quite easy way. ...
translated: Bueno, hace un tiempo se usaron poderosos dispositivos mágicos alrededor de Tibia. Estas son brújulas recargables. Sólo había un problema: ofrecían la posibilidad de enriquecer a la gente de una manera bastante fácil. ...

en: Therefore, these instruments were very coveted. People tried to get their hands on them at all costs. And so it happened what everybody feared - bloody battles forged ahead. ...
translated: Por eso, estos instrumentos eran muy codiciados. La gente intentó apoderarse de ellos a toda costa. Y así sucedió lo que todo el mundo temía: se avecinaban sangrientas batallas. ...

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: La vida y la muerte son partes importantes del equilibrio.

en: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
translated: La vida y la muerte son partes importantes del equilibrio.

en: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
translated: Los cazadores viven una vida de libertad y cercanía a la naturaleza, a diferencia de un simple granjero o pastor de insectos.

en: ... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... <m>
translated: ...sobre Tibia vinieron a vengar a sus amigos, y mataron a casi todos... <m>

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
translated: Ahoi, joven |PLAYERNAME| y bienvenido a Nordic Tibia Ferries. Si necesitas un {passage}, házmelo saber.

en: ... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. <m>
translated: ... los orcos regresaron a sus ciudades. La ciudad de Carlin fue rescatada. <m>

en: ... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best CITY in whole of Tibia.
translated: ... de nuestro rey Tibiano III quería construir la mejor CIUDAD de todo Tibia.

en: Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... <m>
translated: Desde entonces, una mujer siempre ha gobernado sobre Carlin y esta estatua... <m>

en: ... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles*
translated: ... y la Legión Roja. Así que esa fue la historia de Carlin y estos Campos de Gloria. Espero que te haya gustado. *Él sonríe*

en: I will tell you a small secret now. My friend Lynda in Thais can create a blessed wand. Greet her from me, maybe she will aid you.
translated: Te contaré un pequeño secreto ahora. Mi amiga Lynda en Thais puede crear una varita bendita. Saludala de mi parte, tal vez ella te ayude.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
translated: ¿El Druid de Crunor? ¿Te dijo que aquí apareció una nueva cueva? Así es. Soy el jefe de un {project} que intenta saber más sobre este nuevo {area}.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
translated: ¿El Druid de Crunor? ¿Te dijo que aquí apareció una nueva cueva? Así es. Soy el líder de un proyecto que intenta conocer más sobre esta nueva área.

en: The mission should be simple to fulfil. For our excavations we have ordered a sturdy pickaxe in Kazordoon. You would have to seek out this trader Uzgod and get the pickaxe for us ...
translated: La misión debería ser sencilla de cumplir. Para nuestras excavaciones hemos encargado un pico robusto en Kazordoon. Tendrías que buscar a este comerciante Uzgod y conseguirnos el pico...

en: We would like to study some ancient runes that were used by the lizard race. We suspect some relation of the lizards to the founders of Ankrahmun ...
translated: Nos gustaría estudiar algunas runas antiguas que usaba la raza de los lagartos. Sospechamos alguna relación de los lagartos con los fundadores de Ankrahmun...

en: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards...
translated: En algún lugar bajo la ciudad infestada de simios de Banuta, se pueden encontrar mazmorras que alguna vez estuvieron habitadas por lagartos...

en: Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure...
translated: Busque allí una estructura atípica que más bien se ajuste a Ankrahmun y sus Ankrahmun Tumbas. Copia las runas que encontrarás en esta estructura...

en: As far as we know the ruins found in the north-west of Edron were once inhabited by beings who used such stones. Do you have the heart to go there and to get us such a stone?
translated: Hasta donde sabemos, las ruinas encontradas en el noroeste de Edron alguna vez estuvieron habitadas por seres que usaban este tipo de piedras. ¿Tienes el valor de ir allí y conseguirnos esa piedra?

en: For sure someone in Ab'Dendriel will own a copy. So you would just have to ask around there. Are you willing to accept this mission?
translated: Seguramente alguien en Ab'Dendriel tendrá una copia. Así que habría que preguntar por ahí. ¿Estás dispuesto a aceptar esta misión?

en: We want to learn more about the ancient race of bonelords. We believe the black pyramid north east of Darashia was originally built by them ...
translated: Queremos aprender más sobre la antigua raza de los señores de los huesos. Creemos que la pirámide negra al noreste de Darashia fue construida originalmente por ellos...

en: And remember: it's a small teleport for you, but a big teleport for all Tibians! Here is a small present for your efforts!
translated: Y recuerda: ¡es un teletransporte pequeño para ti, pero un teletransporte grande para todos los Tibianos! ¡Aquí tienes un pequeño regalo por tus esfuerzos!

en: That is quite courageous. We know, it's much we are asking for. The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. It is rumoured that her lair is located in the deepest dungeons beneath that cursed place ...
translated: Eso es bastante valiente. Lo sabemos, es mucho lo que estamos pidiendo. La reina de las banshees vive en las llamadas Tierras Fantasma, al suroeste de Carlin. Se rumorea que su guarida se encuentra en las mazmorras más profundas debajo de ese lugar maldito...

en: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
translated: ¿Recibiste el pico solicitado por Uzgod en Kazordoon?

en: In this mission we require you to get us some plant samples from Tiquandan plants. Would you like to fulfil this mission?
translated: En esta misión le pedimos que nos consiga algunas muestras de plantas de Tiquandan. ¿Te gustaría cumplir esta misión?

en: The explorer society would like to acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda. Would you like to accept this mission?
translated: A la sociedad de exploradores le gustaría adquirir una urna antigua que sea una especie de reliquia para el pueblo lagarto de Tiquanda. ¿Te gustaría aceptar esta misión?

en: We will see if you can handle this simple task. Get the pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon and bring it to one of our bases. Report there about the pickaxe.
translated: Veremos si puedes realizar esta sencilla tarea. Consigue el pico de Uzgod en Kazordoon y llévalo a una de nuestras bases. Informe allí sobre el pico.

en: You have indeed the spirit of an adventurer! In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people ...
translated: ¡De hecho tienes el espíritu de un aventurero! En el sureste de Tiquanda hay un pequeño asentamiento del pueblo lagarto...

en: Excellent! So travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid ...
translated: ¡Excelente! Así que viaja a la ciudad de Darashia y luego dirígete al noreste hacia la pirámide...

en: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
translated: Excelente. Esta misión es fácil pero no obstante vital. Viaja a Ab'Dendriel y consigue el libro.

en: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
translated: En las ruinas del noroeste de Edron deberías poder encontrar una piedra de la memoria. Buena suerte.

en: What a strange map. I wonder if any of our explorers recognises this coastal lines. However, you earned yourself another chance to convince me. Why do you think that Farmine would be interesting for us?
translated: Qué mapa tan extraño. Me pregunto si alguno de nuestros exploradores reconoce estas líneas costeras. Sin embargo, te ganaste otra oportunidad de convencerme. ¿Por qué crees que Farmine sería interesante para nosotros?

en: We can bring you to Thais with one of our coaches for 125 gold. Are you interested?
translated: Podemos llevarte a Thais con uno de nuestros entrenadores por 125 de oro. ¿Estás interesado?

en: The sailors always tell tales about the famous beer of Carlin. You must know, alcohol is forbidden in that city. ...
translated: Los marineros siempre cuentan historias sobre la famosa cerveza de Carlin. Debes saber que el alcohol está prohibido en esa ciudad. ...

en: Did you get a sample of the whisper beer from Carlin?
translated: ¿Recibiste una muestra de la cerveza susurrada de Carlin?

en: You have to know, I was one of them before I opened that shop here. Sure they fear about their hideout being revealed by me. Please go to the north, there is a small cave in the mountains with a rock in the middle. ...
translated: Tienes que saber que yo era uno de ellos antes de abrir esa tienda aquí. Seguro que temen que yo revele su escondite. Dirígete hacia el norte, hay una pequeña cueva en las montañas con una roca en el medio. ...

en: My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
translated: My name is Marcus. I run this shop.

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
translated: Realmente debería vender algunos vestidos elegantes o algo así. Nosotros, los tibianos, nunca conseguimos ropa de última moda. Es una pena.

en: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
translated: Los brujos poderosos me asustan un poco.

en: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
translated: Los druidas rara vez visitan una ciudad, ¿qué sabes sobre los druidas?

en: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Pero hay un hada que una vez me lo contó. Quizás ella comparta sus conocimientos. Puedes encontrarla en un pequeño pueblo de hadas en el suroeste de Feyrist.

en: A long time ago a pixie knight of Maelyrra carried it with her. But when she was flying above the waves she accidentally dropped it and it sunk. I found it but now you may take it and use it to help Feyrist.
translated: Hace mucho tiempo, un caballero duendecillo de Maelyrra lo llevaba consigo. Pero cuando volaba sobre las olas, accidentalmente lo dejó caer y se hundió. Lo encontré pero ahora puedes tomarlo y usarlo para ayudar a Feyrist.

en: There is a fairy who once told me about this spell. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
translated: Hay un hada que una vez me habló de este hechizo. Quizás ella comparta sus conocimientos. Puedes encontrarla en un pequeño pueblo de hadas en el suroeste de Feyrist.

en: I'm tired of all these young unskilled wannabe heroes. Every Tibian can show his skills or actions by wearing a special outfit. To prove oneself worthy of the demon outfit, this is how it goes: ...
translated: Estoy cansado de todos estos jóvenes aspirantes a héroes no calificados. Cada Tibiano puede mostrar sus habilidades o acciones usando un atuendo especial. Para demostrar que eres digno del traje de demonio, así es como se hace: ...

en: I grant you three chests - filled to the lid with platinum coins, a house in the city in which you may reside, a set of the finest armor Zao has to offer, and a casket of never-ending mana. ...
translated: Te concedo tres cofres: llenos hasta el tope con monedas de platino, una casa en la ciudad en la que puedes residir, una de las mejores armaduras que Zao tiene para ofrecer y un cofre de maná interminable. ...

en: His identity is still unknown but we have been told that the thief fled to the human settlement called Carlin. I want you to find him and report back to me. Nobody messes with the Efreet and lives to tell the tale! ...
translated: Aún se desconoce su identidad pero nos han dicho que el ladrón huyó al asentamiento humano llamado Carlin. Quiero que lo encuentres y me informes. ¡Nadie se mete con el Efreet y vive para contarlo! ...

en: Now go! Travel to the northern city Carlin! Keep your eyes open and look around for something that might give you a clue!
translated: ¡Ahora vete! ¡Viaja a la ciudad del norte Carlin! ¡Mantén los ojos abiertos y busca algo que pueda darte una pista!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Mmmm... no lo creo. ¡Regrese a Thais y continúe su búsqueda!

en: Then go to Carlin and search for him! Look for something that might give you a clue!
translated: ¡Entonces ve a Carlin y búscalo! ¡Busca algo que pueda darte una pista!

en: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
translated: Mmmm... no lo creo. ¡Regrese a Thais y continúe su búsqueda!

en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

en: My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
translated: My name is Marcus. I run this shop.

translated: La vida toma muchas formas. Las plantas son una forma de vida muy básica. Su sencillez los acerca al núcleo de la naturaleza.

en: I don't claim to understand this creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
translated: No pretendo entender a estas criaturas, pero a veces están más cerca de las raíces que nosotros.

en: By all that is holy! You are a truly great warrior! With much patience! I have just found out the location the hideout of The Horned Fox! I have marked the spot on your map so you can find it. Go there and slay him!! ...
translated: ¡Por todo lo santo! ¡Eres un verdadero gran guerrero! ¡Con mucha paciencia! ¡Acabo de descubrir la ubicación del escondite del Zorro Horned! He marcado el lugar en tu mapa para que puedas encontrarlo. ¡¡Ve allí y mátalo!! ...

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: ¡Quiero que mates a 5000 minotauros, sin importar dónde, por mí y por todos los enanos de Kazordoon! ¿Estás dispuesto a hacer eso?

en: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
translated: ¡Quiero que mates a 5000 minotauros, sin importar dónde, por mí y por todos los enanos de Kazordoon! ¿Estás dispuesto a hacer eso?

en: Funny that you are asking me for a mission! There is indeed something you can do for me. Ever heard about The Horned Fox? Anyway, yesterday his gang has stolen my mining helmet during a raid. ...
translated: ¡Qué curioso que me pidas una misión! De hecho, hay algo que puedes hacer por mí. ¿Has oído hablar alguna vez del zorro Horned? De todos modos, ayer su banda me robó el casco de minero durante una redada. ...

en: We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox is somewhere in the south-west near the coast, good luck finding my mining helmet!
translated: Suponemos que el escondite del Zorro Horned está en algún lugar del suroeste cerca de la costa. ¡Buena suerte para encontrar mi casco de minero!

en: Well, I could need help with that damn Horned Fox and his gang, but I guess since you are rather experienced, killing minotaurs would bore you to death. I'll wait for someone else. But thanks!
translated: Bueno, podría necesitar ayuda con ese maldito Horned Fox y su pandilla, pero supongo que como tienes bastante experiencia, matar minotauros te aburriría muchísimo. Esperaré a alguien más. ¡Pero gracias!

en: I knew you have the guts for that task! We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox somewhere in the south-west near the coast. Good luck!
translated: ¡Sabía que tenías las agallas para esa tarea! Suponemos que el escondite del Zorro Horned se encuentra en algún lugar del suroeste, cerca de la costa. ¡Buena suerte!

en: The hideout of the Horned Fox is probably a dangerous if not lethal place for inexperienced adventurers. It is the source of all the {trouble} around here.
translated: El escondite del Zorro Horned es probablemente un lugar peligroso, si no letal, para aventureros inexpertos. Es la fuente de todo el {trouble} por aquí.

en: He is a minotaur who was kicked out of Mintwallin. He must have some kind of {hideout} nearby.
translated: Es un minotauro que fue expulsado de Mintwallin. Debe tener algún tipo de {hideout} cerca.

en: I need a courier to deliver a parcel to the watchtower in Femor Hills. You think you can handle that??
translated: Necesito un mensajero para entregar un paquete en la atalaya de Femor Hills. ¿Crees que puedes manejar eso?

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: ¡Nuestra familia ha estado sirviendo al ejército Carlin desde incontables generaciones!

en: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
translated: ¡Nuestra familia ha estado sirviendo al ejército Carlin desde incontables generaciones!

en: She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
translated: Ella es una de mis queridas hermanas y sirve a Carlin como guardia de la ciudad.

en: Behave yourself as long as you are in Carlin, commoner!
Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
translated: ¡Saludos, |PLAYERNAME|! Debes haber mejorado bastante. Siempre estoy interesado en aprender cosas nuevas sobre Zao.

en: I think in the past, the lizardmen of this country might have worshipped a snake god or goddess just like their brethren in Tiquanda if we can believe the reports from this area. The dragons replaced the snake worship at some point of history. ...
translated: Creo que en el pasado, los hombres lagarto de este país podrían haber adorado a un dios o diosa serpiente al igual que sus hermanos en Tiquanda si podemos creer los informes de esta área. Los dragones reemplazaron el culto a las serpientes en algún momento de la historia. ...

en: His name was Zao and his deeds and exploits are immortalised in lizard folklore. Some of the earliest records in the tomes suggest a slightly different story though. ...
translated: Su nombre era Zao y sus hazañas y hazañas están inmortalizadas en el folclore de los lagartos. Sin embargo, algunos de los registros más antiguos de los tomos sugieren una historia ligeramente diferente. ...

en: Many records talk about an early lizard dynasty, but I doubt that Zao was a single person born into that dynasty. ...
translated: Muchos registros hablan de una dinastía temprana de lagartos, pero dudo que Zao fuera una sola persona nacida en esa dinastía. ...

en: My guess is that several members of this dynasty are responsible for or connected to the feats that were attributed to the mythical 'Zao'. ...
translated: Supongo que varios miembros de esta dinastía son responsables o están relacionados con las hazañas que se atribuyeron al mítico 'Zao'. ...

en: The improbable lifespan of 'Zao' can thus be explained with the time the Zao dynasty reigned. On the other hand, we all know larger-than-life heroes did exist and some of them had an extremely long lifespan. ...
translated: La improbable esperanza de vida de 'Zao' puede explicarse por tanto con el tiempo que reinó la dinastía Zao. Por otro lado, todos sabemos que existieron héroes gigantes y que algunos de ellos tuvieron una vida útil extremadamente larga. ...

en: Most likely, he also had children which could explain the mentioning of a Zao family. I think even the lizardmen don't know for sure what happened in such distant past and so this might be one of those riddles that will never be solved. ...
translated: Lo más probable es que también tuviera hijos, lo que podría explicar la mención de una familia Zao. Creo que ni siquiera los hombres lagarto saben con seguridad qué pasó en un pasado tan lejano y por eso este podría ser uno de esos acertijos que nunca se resolverán. ...

en: It seems that the origin of the Zao dynasty was somewhere in the Dragonblaze Peaks, or rather under them. Legends tell of a large fortress, once erected up the highest peak, but now buried deep underground. Who knows, maybe you'll find answers there?
translated: Parece que el origen de la dinastía Zao estuvo en algún lugar de los Picos Dragonblaze, o más bien debajo de ellos. Las leyendas hablan de una gran fortaleza, una vez erigida en el pico más alto, pero ahora enterrada a gran profundidad. Quién sabe, tal vez encuentres respuestas allí.

en: In the parts of the original text that I was able to reconstruct with the help of some alchemy, there were some references to lizard spawns that were sighted in the Tiquanda area and linked to the snake god. ...
translated: En las partes del texto original que pude reconstruir con la ayuda de algo de alquimia, había algunas referencias a engendros de lagartos que fueron avistados en el área Tiquanda y vinculados al dios serpiente. ...

en: Anyway, you know what else was mentioned in this book? A path down to a hidden cave system below the Muggy Plains. ...
translated: De todos modos, ¿sabes qué más se mencionó en este libro? Un camino que conduce a un sistema de cuevas ocultas debajo del Muggy Plains. ...

en: Have you ever seen the towers of the large lizard city south-east of Zao? It's the last one south of the mountains and who knows how long they are able to hold it. ...
translated: ¿Has visto alguna vez las torres de la gran ciudad de los lagartos al sureste de Zao? Es el último al sur de las montañas y quién sabe cuánto tiempo podrán aguantar. ...

en: I discovered an interesting recipe in this Tome of Knowledge. Maybe you've seen the large rice terraces in Muggy Plains - that is how the lizardmen apparently call that region. ...
translated: Descubrí una receta interesante en este Tomo de Knowledge. Tal vez hayas visto las grandes terrazas de arroz en Muggy Plains; así es como aparentemente los hombres lagarto llaman a esa región. ...

en: Did you know that most of the minotaurs you might have met by now do not originally come from Zao? The original minotaur race stood no chance against the united force of dragons and lizards. ...
translated: ¿Sabías que la mayoría de los minotauros que quizás ya hayas conocido no provienen originalmente de Zao? La raza de minotauros original no tenía ninguna posibilidad contra la fuerza unida de dragones y lagartos. ...

en: The Mooh'Tah masters actually found the continent Zao and started to look for their lost brothers, but it doesn't say whether they actually found any survivors. ...
translated: Los maestros de Mooh'Tah realmente encontraron el continente Zao y comenzaron a buscar a sus hermanos perdidos, pero no dice si realmente encontraron sobrevivientes. ...

en: Did you know that the lizardmen were among the first races roaming this continent? They were waging war against the orcs, minotaurs and humans on Zao and for a long time it seemed that the forces were even. ...
translated: ¿Sabías que los hombres lagarto estuvieron entre las primeras razas que vagaron por este continente? Estaban librando una guerra contra los orcos, los minotauros y los humanos en Zao y durante mucho tiempo pareció que las fuerzas estaban igualadas. ...

en: Dragons are of great symbolism for this land. Even before the dragons came here and took control over Zao, the lizards worshipped the dragons as strong mythical beasts. ...
translated: Dragons son de gran simbolismo para esta tierra. Incluso antes de que los dragones vinieran aquí y tomaran el control de Zao, los lagartos adoraban a los dragones como fuertes bestias míticas. ...

translated: ¡Muchas personas que navegaron a Darashia nunca regresaron porque fueron atacadas por un barco fantasma! ¡Nunca navegaré allí!

en: By direct edict of the honorable Henricus, we are ordered to give passage for all recruits to Thais.
translated: Por edicto directo del honorable Henricus, se nos ordena dar paso a todos los reclutas a Thais.

en: Do you seek a passage to Thais for |TRAVELCOST|?
By direct edict of the honorable Henricus himself... well, you know.
translated: Por edicto directo del honorable Henricus mismo... bueno, ya sabes.

en: By edict of the honorable Henricus himself, we are ordered to give passage to all recruits of the Roshamuul mission for a small fee.
translated: Por edicto del honorable Henricus, se nos ordena dar paso a todos los reclutas de la misión Roshamuul por una pequeña tarifa.

en: I can bring you to our base in Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|. Is that what you want?
translated: Puedo llevarte a nuestra base en Liberty Bay por |TRAVELCOST|. ¿Es eso lo que quieres?

en: Kid, listen. Answering with a clear {yes} or {no} will get you much further in Tibia. \z Most people are not as sharp-eared as I am. Got that?
translated: Chico, escucha. Responder con un {yes} o {no} claro lo llevará mucho más lejos en Tibia. \z La mayoría de la gente no es tan perspicaz como yo. ¿Entendiste eso?

en: No fear! The Sea Cat will ship you safely to the mainland!
translated: ¡Sin miedo! ¡El Sea Cat te llevará sano y salvo al continente!

en:
She's pretty, isn't she? Will ship you safely to any port. Though a young landlubber such as you should \z
	consider to travel to Thais first. The travel is for free. Just once though! You have to ask for a {passage}.
translated:
Ella es bonita, ¿no? Lo enviaremos de manera segura a cualquier puerto. Aunque un joven marinero de agua dulce como tú deberías \z
	considere viajar a Thais primero. El viaje es gratis. ¡Pero sólo una vez! Tienes que pedir un {passage}.

translated: No voy a navegar allí. ¡Esta ruta está afectada por un barco fantasma! Sin embargo, he oído que el Capitán Fearless de Venore navega allí.

translated: Mi nombre es Capitán Greyhound de la línea Royal Tibia.

en: Ah, you may not have heard of me. I am Captain Gulliver, the first Oramondian for a hundred years to have sailed through the mist to your strange lands.
translated: Ah, puede que no hayas oído hablar de mí. Soy el Capitán Gulliver, el primer oramondiano en cien años que navegó a través de la niebla hacia vuestras extrañas tierras.

en: The 'Sea Goddess' is the most beautiful in Oramond, a whole new model of ship, elegant, sure and swift. There's no weather she can't take!
translated: El 'Sea Goddess' es el más bello del Oramond, un modelo de barco completamente nuevo, elegante, seguro y veloz. ¡No hay clima que no pueda soportar!

en: Ah, your lands are quite a sight! I have only visited Thais so far, but I think of navigating to more cities, when the time - and public demand - comes.
translated: ¡Ah, tus tierras son todo un espectáculo! Hasta ahora solo he visitado Thais, pero pienso en navegar a más ciudades, cuando llegue el momento (y la demanda del público).

en: Passages to Thais and Krailos! Visit the strange lands!
translated: Pasajes a Thais y Krailos! ¡Visita las tierras extrañas!

en: It's a fine library, isn't it?
translated: It's a fine library, isn't it?

en: I can hear the call of the forest.
translated: I can hear the call of the forest.

en: What's left to do now is seek out Merikh the Slaughterer, an especially cruel Efreet. He hides somewhere in Yalahar. I don't know if you can kill him, but you should at least try.
translated: Pozostało teraz odszukać Merichha Rzeźnika, szczególnie okrutnego Efreeta. Ukrywa się gdzieś w Yalahar. Nie wiem, czy dasz radę go zabić, ale przynajmniej spróbuj.

en: There's a camp of outlaws to the east of Thais. Rumour has it that people are going missing but it's not linked to the bandits. ...
translated: Na wschód od Thais znajduje się obóz bandytów. Plotka głosi, że ludzie znikają, ale nie jest to powiązane z bandytami. ...

en:
Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ... \z
	They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
translated:
Nimfy są żeńskimi duchami natury i zwykle przybierają postać pięknych, młodych dziewcząt, które uwielbiają tańczyć i śpiewać. Mieszkają na wzgórzach i w lasach Feyrist, często w pobliżu jezior i strumieni i nie mogą umrzeć ze starości ani chorób. ... \ z
	Mają specjalną, silną więź z roślinami i zwierzętami na swoim terenie i bardzo chronią florę i faunę Feyrist. Jak powiedział mi Maelyrra, nimfy wyłaniają się ze snów śmiertelników o miłości.

en: Hello and welcome in the Gnomprona Gardens. If you want to change your {hazard} level, I 'm who you're looking for.
translated: Witamy w Gnomprona Ogrodach. Jeśli chcesz zmienić swój poziom {hazard}, 'm who you' szukam.

en: I'm deeply impressed, brave Knight |PLAYERNAME|. I expected nothing less from you. Now, please retrieve Ramsay's helmet.
translated: Jestem pod wielkim wrażeniem, odważny Knight |PLAYERNAME|. Niczego innego się po tobie nie spodziewałem. A teraz proszę odzyskać hełm Ramsaya.

en: I know Marvik in Thais. He once helped me with a furuncle I had on my ...ahh, doesn't matter. He's a nice gran'pa, though!
translated: Conozco a Marvik en Thais. Una vez me ayudó con un furúnculo que tenía en el...ahh, no importa. ¡Pero es un buen abuelo!

en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE LARBOARD SIDE!!
translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A BALAR !!

en: IS THAT ALL?!? SPEED UP, TIGHTEN THE MAINSAIL!!!
translated: ¿¡¿ESO ES TODO?!? ¡¡¡ACELERAR, APRETAR LA VELA MAYOR!!!

en: Already got enough, huh? I kind o' expected that, landlubber! Let's head for Svargrond! Ready?
translated: Ya tengo suficiente, ¿eh? ¡Me lo esperaba, marinero de agua dulce! ¡Vayamos hacia Svargrond! ¿Listo?

en: Y' already wanna give up?? I should've known. I bring ya back to Svargrond, 'kay?
translated: ¿Ya quieres rendirte? Debería haberlo sabido. Te traigo de regreso a Svargrond, ¿vale?

en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT ON THE STARBOARD SIDE!!
translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA A ESTRIBOR!!

en: LOOKOUT REPORTS SEA SERPENT ON SIGHT!! STRAIGHT AHEAD!!
translated: ¡¡MIRADOR INFORMA SERPIENTE MARINA A LA VISTA!! ¡¡TODO DERECHO!!

en: SET FULL SAILS! SEA SERPENT RIGHT IN FRONT OF US!!
translated: ¡LEVAN LAS VELAS A TODO LADO! ¡¡SERPIENTE MARINA JUSTO FRENTE A NOSOTROS!!

en: Do you seek a passage back to Tibia?
translated: ¿Buscas un pasaje de regreso a Tibia?

en: Do you want go back to Liberty Bay?

translated: Pasajes a Edron, Darashia, Oramond, Thais y Venore.

translated: Este es Ab'Dendriel. ¿A dónde quieres ir?

translated: Mi nombre es Capitán Gaviota de la Línea Royal Tibia.

en: My name is Captain Seahorse from the Royal Tibia Line.
translated: Mi nombre es Capitán Seahorse de la línea Royal Tibia.

en: This is Edron. Where do you want to go?
translated: Este es Edron. ¿A dónde quieres ir?

en: I'm sorry, but we don't serve this route. However, I heard that Wyrdin here in Edron is looking for adventurers to go on a trip to Yalahar for him.
translated: Lo siento, pero no atendemos esta ruta. Sin embargo, escuché que Wyrdin aquí en Edron está buscando aventureros para ir de viaje a Yalahar por él.

en: Do you seek a passage back to Liberty Bay for |TRAVELCOST|?
translated: ¿Busca un pasaje de regreso a Liberty Bay para |TRAVELCOST|?

en: My father wanted me to marry a wealthy Venorean. He understood so little about love and the ways of the heart.
translated: Mi padre quería que me casara con un venoreano rico. Entendía muy poco sobre el amor y los caminos del corazón.

en: We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never know what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
translated: Ponemos toda nuestra esperanza en esta lejana colonia. Lamentablemente, nunca llegamos allí y nunca sabré cómo habría sido nuestra vida en Port Hope.

en: The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
translated: Las bulliciosas calles de Thais son sólo un vago recuerdo para mí.

en: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
translated: Ahoi, joven |PLAYERNAME| y bienvenido a Nordic Tibia Ferries. Si necesitas un {passage}, házmelo saber.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
translated: ¿El Druid de Crunor? ¿Te dijo que aquí apareció una nueva cueva? Así es. Soy el jefe de un {project} que intenta saber más sobre este nuevo {area}.

en: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
translated: ¿El Druid de Crunor? ¿Te dijo que aquí apareció una nueva cueva? Así es. Soy el líder de un proyecto que intenta conocer más sobre esta nueva área.

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.
translated: Carlin es una ciudad encantadora y verde, que yo recuerde.

en: Wha ... What??? Are you saying you've seen a mouse here??
translated: ¿Qué... qué??? ¿Estás diciendo que has visto un ratón aquí?

en: Hello again, |PLAYERNAME|! What are you still doing here? You should head over the bridge to Rookgaard village now!
translated: ¡Hola de nuevo, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Qué sigues haciendo aquí? ¡Deberías cruzar el puente hacia la aldea Rookgaard ahora!

en: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|! Well, that's how trading with NPCs like me works. I think you are ready now to cross the bridge to Rookgaard! Take care!
translated: ¡Hola, |PLAYERNAME|! Bueno, así es como funciona el comercio con NPC como yo. ¡Creo que ya estás listo para cruzar el puente hacia Rookgaard! ¡Cuidarse!

en: Very nice! Food for me! Sell it to me, fast! Once you sold your food to me, just say {ready} to let me know you are done.
translated: ¡Muy lindo! ¡Comida para mí! ¡Véndemelo, rápido! Una vez que me hayas vendido tu comida, simplemente di {ready} para informarme que ya terminaste.

en: Good bye traveller and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
translated: Adiós viajero y disfruta de tu estancia en Rookgaard.

en: I hope that I am not asking too much of you with this task. I heard of a flower which is currently unique in Tibia and can survive at only one place. ...
translated: Espero no pedirte demasiado con esta tarea. Escuché sobre una flor que actualmente es única en Tibia y puede sobrevivir en un solo lugar. ...

en: In the mountains between Ankrahmun and Tiquanda are two hydra lairs. The nothern one has many waterfalls whereas the southern one has just tiny water trickles. ...
translated: En las montañas entre Ankrahmun y Tiquanda hay dos guaridas de hidras. El del norte tiene muchas cascadas, mientras que el del sur tiene sólo pequeños hilos de agua. ...

en: However, these trickles are said to contain water as pure and clean as nowhere else in Tibia. ...
translated: Sin embargo, se dice que estos chorritos contienen agua tan pura y limpia como en ningún otro lugar de Tibia. ...

en: Unfortunately, my intrusion was discovered and I had to run for my life. During my escape, I lost my favourite wolf tooth chain.
translated: Desafortunadamente, mi intrusión fue descubierta y tuve que huir para salvar mi vida. Durante mi fuga, perdí mi cadena de dientes de lobo favorita.

en: I can give you a new one, but I fear that I have to take a small fee for it. Would you like to buy a waterskin for 1000 gold?
translated: Puedo regalarte uno nuevo, pero me temo que tendré que cobrar una pequeña tarifa por ello. ¿Te gustaría comprar un odre de agua por 1000 de oro?

en: Right, I will keep my promise. Faolan roams Tibia freely, but her favourite sleeping cave is on Cormaya. I will now enchant you so you will be able to speak the wolf language.
translated: Bien, cumpliré mi promesa. Faolan deambula libremente por Tibia, pero su cueva para dormir favorita está en Cormaya. Ahora te encantaré para que puedas hablar el idioma del lobo.

en: Few ship captains would sail this route. But if you want to take the risk, I can bring you to Thais, Edron, Liberty Bay or Yalahar for less gold than usual. Interested?
translated: Pocos capitanes de barco navegarían por esta ruta. Pero si quieres correr el riesgo, puedo llevarte a Thais, Edron, Liberty Bay o Yalahar por menos oro de lo habitual. ¿Interesado?

en: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
translated: Pasajes a Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay y Yalahar.

en: Passages to Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
translated: Pasajes a Thais, Darashia, Edron, Venore, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay y Yalahar.

en: Fine. You have {} \z attunements left. What is the new city of your choice? Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Port Hope?
translated: Bien. Te quedan {} \z sintonizaciones. ¿Cuál es la nueva ciudad de tu elección? ¿Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Kazordoon, Venore, \z Ankrahmun, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay o Port Hope?

en: And if you head to Zalamon, be zure to inform him about our zituation. Food rationz are running low and we are ztill not well equipped. We need to eztablish a working zupply line.
translated: Y si te diriges a Zalamon, no olvides informarle sobre nuestra situación. Las raciones de alimentos se están agotando y todavía no estamos bien equipados. Necesitamos establecer una línea de suministro que funcione.

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - helping us, helps you in the long term, trust me.
translated: Si puedes encontrar algunos de los {roots} nutritivos y jugosos en las afueras de Rathleton, tráelos aquí. Estaremos encantados de aceptar paquetes de cinco raíces cada uno y, oye, ayudarnos te ayudará a largo plazo, créeme.

en: Just recently we were able to secretly help our elven friends to exposure an agitator sent by Carlin to poison our connections with them. The elves' reaction wasswift and without compromise ...
translated: Recientemente pudimos ayudar en secreto a nuestros amigos elfos a exponer a un agitador enviado por Carlin para envenenar nuestras conexiones con ellos. La reacción de los elfos fue rápida y sin concesiones...

en: These papers can tell us much about Carlin's plans in the North. We need you to enter 'Hellgate' and to retrieve the papers for us ...
translated: Estos artículos pueden decirnos mucho sobre los planes de Carlin en el Norte. Necesitamos que ingreses 'Hellgate' y nos recuperes los papeles...

en: One of our agents is missing. He was investigating the cause for the slow growth of our colony Port Hope ...
translated: Uno de nuestros agentes está desaparecido. Estaba investigando la causa del lento crecimiento de nuestra colonia Port Hope...

en: You will continue these investigations at the point where the information that the lost agent has sent us ends. Some of the traders in Port Hope must have connections to persons who are interested in sabotaging our efforts in Tiquanda ...
translated: Continuarás estas investigaciones en el punto donde termina la información que nos ha enviado el agente perdido. Algunos de los comerciantes en Port Hope deben tener conexiones con personas que estén interesadas en sabotear nuestros esfuerzos en Tiquanda...

en: A mad dwarven technomancer that listens to the name of Blowbeard sent us a blackmailing letter. He demands to deliver all of Thais's gold to him. Else he will destroy the city with an artificial earthquake caused by one of his machines! ...
translated: Un tecnomante enano loco que escucha el nombre de Blowbeard nos envió una carta de chantaje. Exige entregarle todo el oro de Thais. ¡De lo contrario, destruirá la ciudad con un terremoto artificial causado por una de sus máquinas! ...

en: As he is already missing since decades it is unlikely that he is still alive. Nevertheless, we want you to find out something about the whereabouts of our agent in the ruins in the Green Claw Swamp, north west of Venore ...
translated: Como lleva desaparecido décadas, es poco probable que siga vivo. Sin embargo, queremos que averigües algo sobre el paradero de nuestro agente en las ruinas del Pantano Garra Verde, al noroeste de Venore...

en: Your first task is to deliver a warning. Illegally, the Venoreans are crafting more ships than the Thaian authorities have allowed them ...
translated: Su primera tarea es dar una advertencia. Ilegalmente, los venoreanos están fabricando más barcos de los que las autoridades tailandesas les han permitido...

en: An official note would strain the relationship between Thais and Venore too much as this would mean that we had to admit officially that we know about those activities ...
translated: Una nota oficial tensaría demasiado la relación entre Thais y Venore ya que esto significaría que tendríamos que admitir oficialmente que conocemos esas actividades...

en: Still, we can't allow them to continue like this. It will be your task to let them know that we do not tolerate such behaviour. Get a fire bug from Liberty Bay and set their shipyard on fire ...
translated: Aún así, no podemos permitir que sigan así. Será su tarea hacerles saber que no toleramos tal comportamiento. Consigue un insecto de fuego de Liberty Bay y prende fuego a su astillero...

en: We need you to find his base in Kazordoon and to kill him before he can use his infernal machine. Bring us his beard as proof of your success.
translated: Necesitamos que encuentres su base en Kazordoon y lo mates antes de que pueda usar su máquina infernal. Tráenos su barba como prueba de tu éxito.

en: You will swear allegiance to Thais alone and abandon the service of any other city. So is it really your wish to become one of our field agents?
translated: Jurarás lealtad solo a Thais y abandonarás el servicio de cualquier otra ciudad. Entonces, ¿realmente desea convertirse en uno de nuestros agentes de campo?

en: The women of Carlin have the northern city Svargrond in the firm grip of her manicured hands. At the moment, there is little we can do about it but there is one thing that plays into our hands ...
translated: Las mujeres de Carlin tienen la ciudad del norte Svargrond en el firme control de sus cuidadas manos. De momento, poco podemos hacer al respecto pero hay una cosa que nos juega a nuestro favor…

en: The barbarians have surely at least heard about the fact that alcohol is outlawed in Carlin ...
translated: Seguramente los bárbaros al menos habrán oído hablar de que el alcohol está prohibido en Carlin...

en: It's bad enough that Carlin got a solid foothold in the far North but now the Venoreans also try to move in. They try to gain influence on the barbarian raiders by bribing their leaders or making them great promises ...
translated: Ya es bastante malo que Carlin haya conseguido un punto de apoyo sólido en el extremo norte, pero ahora los venoreanos también intentan mudarse allí. Intentan ganar influencia sobre los asaltantes bárbaros sobornando a sus líderes o haciéndoles grandes promesas...

en: Here is a signet ring that the Venorean emissaries use to wear. 'Lose' the ring in the north-western corner of the highest level of the tower. They will surely find it there.
translated: Aquí hay un anillo de sello que solían usar los emisarios venoreanos. 'Lose' el anillo en la esquina noroeste del nivel más alto de la torre. Seguramente lo encontrarán allí.

en: Now that Venore is of nearly no importance anymore, there is only Carlin left to deal with.
translated: Ahora que Venore ya casi no tiene importancia, solo queda Carlin con el que lidiar.

en: I already heard that our little trick worked quite well. Several officials of Carlin are already on their way to repair the damage done to their diplomatic efforts. It will not only cost them much money but also quite some time.
translated: Ya escuché que nuestro pequeño truco funcionó bastante bien. Varios funcionarios de Carlin ya están en camino de reparar el daño causado a sus esfuerzos diplomáticos. No sólo les costará mucho dinero sino también bastante tiempo.

en: I think they understood the warning the way it was meant. If not, you will have to visit Venore soon again. But for now it's settled.
translated: Creo que entendieron la advertencia tal como estaba prevista. De lo contrario, tendrás que volver a visitar Venore pronto. Pero por ahora está arreglado.

en: Hahaha! Grarkharok take cloak from pretty girl. Then ... girl is swan. Grarkharok wants eat but flies away. Grarkharok not understand. Not need cloak, too many feathers. Give cloak to To ... Ta ... Tereban in Edron. Getting shiny coins and meat.
translated: ¡Jajaja! Grarkharok le quita la capa a una chica bonita. Entonces... la niña es cisne. Grarkharok quiere comer pero se va volando. Grarkharok no lo entiende. No hace falta capa, demasiadas plumas. Dale capa a To...Ta...Tereban en Edron. Conseguir monedas y carne brillantes.

en: Hrhrhrhr! Me no fear of human! Me Chief Grarkharok!!
translated: ¡Hrhrhrhr! ¡No tengo miedo de los humanos! ¡¡Yo, jefe Grarkharok!!

translated: Thais'in güneyindeki beyaz çiçek tapınağında ruhani kalkanı aldığını görüyorum.

en: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
translated: Carlin'in kuzeyindeki druidlerin sana Tibia'nın Kucaklamasını sağladığını hissedebiliyorum.

translated: Ab'Dendriel yakınlarındaki güneş kulesinde iki güneşin kutsağını aldığını görebiliyorum.

en: Secondly, the high ape magicians of Banuta use banana staves. I would love to learn more about these staves, so please bring me 5 of them also. ...
translated: En segundo lugar, los magos simios altos de Banuta usan duelas de plátano. Me encantaría aprender más sobre estos pentagramas, así que tráeme 5 de ellos también. ...

en: This monster, if slain, carries a rare root called Mandrake. If you find it, bring it to me. Also, gather 5 of the voodoo dolls used by the mysterious dworc voodoomasters. ...
translated: Este monstruo, si es asesinado, porta una rara raíz llamada Mandrágora. Si lo encuentras, tráemelo. Además, reúne 5 de los muñecos vudú utilizados por los misteriosos maestros vudú dworc. ...

en: The dworcs of Tiquanda like to wear certain tribal masks which I would like to take a look at. Please bring me 5 of these masks. ...
translated: A los dworcs de Tiquanda les gusta usar ciertas máscaras tribales que me gustaría ver. Por favor tráeme 5 de estas máscaras. ...

en: Very good! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Now, I need a fresh dead black sheep.
translated: ¡Muy bien! <chants and dances> 'You shall face black magic without fear!' Ahora, necesito una oveja negra muerta fresca.

en: Ten prayers for a blessed stake? Don't tell me they made you travel whole Tibia for it! Listen, child, if you bring me a wooden stake, I'll bless it for you. <chuckles>
translated: ¿Diez oraciones por una estaca bendita? ¡No me digas que te hicieron viajar todo Tibia por eso! Escucha, niña, si me traes una estaca de madera, te la bendeciré. <chuckles>

en: If its necessary ... <tells you her measurements>
translated: Si es necesario... <tells you her measurements>

en: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
translated: En nuestro pueblo viven pocas personas, la mayoría son {merchants}. Puedes pedirles un {trade} o sobre varios otros temas, como los nombres de otros ciudadanos, su {job} o Tibia en general.

en: There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
translated: Hay cuatro vocaciones en Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} o {druid}. Cada vocación tiene sus habilidades especiales únicas.

en: Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
translated: Los caballeros son luchadores cuerpo a cuerpo. Suelen empuñar armas cuerpo a cuerpo como espadas, hachas o garrotes.

en: Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
translated: Los druidas son magos de la naturaleza. Su especialidad es lanzar magia de hielo y tierra, además de curar a otros.

en: Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
translated: Los paladines son luchadores a distancia bien entrenados y pueden lanzar magia sagrada. Generalmente los verás usando arcos o ballestas.

en: Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
translated: Los hechiceros son magos elementales. Han dominado la magia del fuego, la energía y la muerte.

Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!

en: To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. \z Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. \z Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
translated: Para ser honesto, temo que el presagio de mis sueños pueda ser cierto. \z Quizás Fugio no pueda ver el peligro que hay allí abajo. \z Quizás... ¿está dispuesto a investigar este asunto?

en: Ahh, Amanda from Edron sent you! I hope she's doing well. So why did she send you here?
translated: ¡Ahh, Amanda de Edron te envió! Espero que le vaya bien. Entonces, ¿por qué te envió aquí?

en: To be honest, I fear the omen in my dreams may be true. Perhaps Fugio is unable to see the danger down there. Perhaps ... you are willing to investigate this matter?
translated: Para ser honesto, temo que el presagio de mis sueños pueda ser cierto. Quizás Fugio no pueda ver el peligro que hay allí abajo. Quizás… ¿estás dispuesto a investigar este asunto?
