en: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
translated: Los monstruos más peligrosos de Rookgaard están al otro lado de este puente.

en: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
translated: Soy el guardia de este puente. Defiendo a Rookgaard contra las bestias del {wilderness} y del {dungeons}, e incluso del apestoso {sewers}.

en: Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
translated: ¿Sabías que las ratas se encuentran entre los animales más peligrosos de todo Tibia? Cada día matan a muchas personas que sobreestiman sus poderes. ¡No seas uno de ellos!

en: Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
translated: Los orcos son una amenaza constante. Hay especies de orcos aún más fuertes en el continente principal.

en: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
translated: Minotaurs son muy fuertes. Necesitarás un grupo de personas o al menos nivel 6 y un buen equipo para poder matarlos.

en: Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
translated: Las avispas son los monstruos más rápidos de esta isla y te envenenan. Si alguna vez te topas con uno y ya tienes mala salud, ¡teme por tu vida!

en: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
translated: Los monstruos más peligrosos de Rookgaard están al otro lado de este puente.

en: So, you are searching for a way to transform Aurita's fishtail into legs temporarily. As you might already have figured out you need some magic for this purpose. There is a place on Feyrist where you can find the arcane energies you need. ...
translated: Entonces, estás buscando una manera de transformar temporalmente la cola de pez de Aurita en patas. Como ya habrás descubierto, necesitas algo de magia para este propósito. Hay un lugar en Feyrist donde puedes encontrar las energías arcanas que necesitas. ...

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: El alcohol vuelve a la gente demasiado agresiva. No necesitamos ese tipo de cosas en Carlin.

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: El alcohol vuelve a la gente demasiado agresiva. No necesitamos ese tipo de cosas en Carlin.

en: Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.
translated: El alcohol vuelve a la gente demasiado agresiva. No necesitamos ese tipo de cosas en Carlin.

en: I'm impressed with your dedication and courage. I can't show you the exact location of cyclopolis on the map though. It is somewhere north of Edron city. ...
translated: Estoy impresionado con su dedicación y coraje. Sin embargo, no puedo mostrarte la ubicación exacta de cyclopolis en el mapa. Está en algún lugar al norte de la ciudad Edron. ...

en: It's not only the trolls invading from the west coast. <sighs> Goblins also have a lair there where they constantly prepare for their next attack. ...
translated: No son sólo los trolls los que invaden desde la costa oeste. <sighs> Goblins también tienen una guarida allí donde se preparan constantemente para su próximo ataque. ...

en: Very well, maybe you know that the orcs here in Edron learnt to raise giant spiders. It is going to become a serious threat. ...
translated: Muy bien, tal vez sepas que los orcos aquí en Edron aprendieron a criar arañas gigantes. Va a convertirse en una seria amenaza. ...

en: We've successfully driven the minotaurs off this island, but the underground city of the cyclopes - Cyclopolis - is still standing. ...
translated: Hemos logrado expulsar a los minotauros de esta isla, pero la ciudad subterránea de los cíclopes, Cyclopolis, sigue en pie. ...

en: We're always looking for adventurers who'd help us decimate the number of cyclopes. Will you assist the city of Edron by killing 500 of them?
translated: Siempre estamos buscando aventureros que nos ayuden a diezmar el número de cíclopes. ¿Ayudarás a la ciudad de Edron matando a 500 de ellos?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 150 goblins. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Otra opción si quieres hacer una tarea para Edron sería matar 150 duendes. ¿Se adaptaría mejor a tus gustos?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to repeat killing 100 trolls. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Otra opción si quieres hacer una tarea para Edron sería repetir matando a 100 trolls. ¿Se adaptaría mejor a tus gustos?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 500 cyclops. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Otra opción si quieres hacer una tarea para Edron sería matar a 500 cíclopes. ¿Se adaptaría mejor a tus gustos?

en: Another option if you want to do a task for Edron would be to killing 300 rotworms. Would that suit your taste better?
translated: Otra opción si quieres hacer una tarea para Edron sería matar 300 gusanos giratorios. ¿Se adaptaría mejor a tus gustos?

en: Maybe you have noticed the numerous rotworms that burrowed under Edron. They're quite a pest. You look strong enough to be able to vanquish a few for us. Do you think you can kill 300 rotworms?
translated: Tal vez hayas notado los numerosos gusanos podridos que excavaron bajo Edron. Son toda una plaga. Pareces lo suficientemente fuerte como para poder vencer a algunos por nosotros. ¿Crees que puedes matar 300 gusanos podridos?

en: I am the governor of this isle, Edron, and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood.
translated: Soy el gobernador de esta isla, Edron, y gran maestro de los Caballeros de la Sangre de Banor.

en: There's a beautiful but very dangerous palace in the Tiquandan jungle. The young women who live there are actually demons and they are luring unsuspecting mortals in there. ...
translated: Hay un palacio hermoso pero muy peligroso en la jungla de Tiquandan. Las mujeres jóvenes que viven allí son en realidad demonios y están atrayendo a mortales desprevenidos allí. ...

en: This noble alliance of honourable knights once resided in Edron to serve the king. Legend has it they vanished practically over night. Rumor has it their disappearance is connected to a forbidden book.
translated: Esta noble alianza de honorables caballeros alguna vez residió en Edron para servir al rey. Cuenta la leyenda que desaparecieron prácticamente de la noche a la mañana. Se rumorea que su desaparición está relacionada con un libro prohibido.

en: Sightings of strange fishmen in Tiquanda are stirring up the region. You should be careful when investigating this. ...
translated: Los avistamientos de extraños pescadores en Tiquanda están agitando la región. Debes tener cuidado al investigar esto. ...

en: As far as I know a scholar in Edron already dealt with fish-like creatures before.
translated: Hasta donde yo sé, un erudito en Edron ya se ocupó antes de criaturas parecidas a peces.

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
translated: Soy el guardia de este puente. Defiendo a Rookgaard contra las bestias del {wilderness} y del {dungeons}, e incluso del apestoso {sewers}.

en: Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
translated: Minotaurs son muy fuertes. Necesitarás un grupo de personas o al menos nivel 6 y un buen equipo para poder matarlos.

en: I have heard that it was recently planned to expand the Museum of Tibian Arts. In the course of these activities unexpected difficulties occurred.
translated: He oído que recientemente se planeó ampliar el Museo de Artes Tibias. En el curso de estas actividades surgieron dificultades inesperadas.

en: There are rumors of a mysterious statue in the desert next to Darashia. Nobody really knows the meaning of it.
translated: Hay rumores de una misteriosa estatua en el desierto junto a Darashia. Nadie sabe realmente su significado.

en: Talk to Captain Charles in Port Hope. He told me that he once ran ashore on a small island where he discovered a small ruin. The architecture was like nothing he had seen before.
translated: Habla con el Capitán Charles en Port Hope. Me dijo que una vez desembarcó corriendo en una pequeña isla donde descubrió una pequeña ruina. La arquitectura no se parecía a nada que hubiera visto antes.

en:
The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ... \z
	The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ... \z
	The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
translated:
Las piezas por sí solas no les sirven de nada. Para ensamblar las piezas se necesita gran habilidad, inmenso poder y conocimientos prohibidos. ...\z
	La habilidad será proporcionada por el caído Yalahari y el poder por el propio Variphor. ...\z
	Lo único que todavía les falta es el conocimiento para montar y operar el {godbreaker}.

en: Time is not important on Fibula.
translated: El tiempo no es importante en Fibula.

en: You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
translated: Estás en Fibula. Esta isla no es muy peligrosa. Sólo los lobos molestan fuera del pueblo.

en: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
translated: Ay dios mío. En la mazmorra de Fibula hay muchos monstruos. Por eso lo hemos sellado con una puerta maciza.

en: Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.
translated: Ay dios mío. En la mazmorra de Fibula hay muchos monstruos. Por eso lo hemos sellado con una puerta maciza.

en: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
translated: El gran edificio en el centro de Rookgaard. Disponen de una biblioteca, un centro de formación, un {bank} y la sala del {oracle}. {Seymore} es el profesor allí.

en: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
translated: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

en: Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
We'd like to ease our lives somewhat. Therefore, we would appreciate the cooperation with one of the Venore city guards. ...
translated: Nos gustaría facilitar un poco nuestras vidas. Por lo tanto, agradeceríamos la cooperación con uno de los guardias de la ciudad Venore. ...

en: Your next job will be kidnapping. You'll get us the only creature that this scrupulous trader Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay holds dear. ...
translated: Tu próximo trabajo será secuestrar. Nos conseguirás la única criatura que este escrupuloso comerciante Theodore Loveless en Liberty Bay aprecia. ...

en: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
translated: Como ya sabrás, vendo ganzúas para cerraduras, pero me temo que, a menos que tengas mucha suerte, no romperás esta costosa obra maestra que es una cerradura. Sin embargo, consíguenos ese pescado, sin importar cómo.

en: Your next mission will lead you to Tiquanda. There is a hidden smugglers cave, north of town. ...
translated: Tu próxima misión te llevará a Tiquanda. Hay una cueva de contrabandistas escondida, al norte de la ciudad. ...

en: You'll disguise yourself as the dwarven ambassador and sell that fool the old dwarven bridge, south of Kazordoon. ...
translated: Te disfrazarás de embajador enano y le venderás a ese tonto el viejo puente enano, al sur de Kazordoon. ...

en: Secondly, you'll need a disguise. Percybald in Carlin is an eccentric actor that might help you with that. ...
translated: En segundo lugar, necesitarás un disfraz. Percybald en Carlin es un actor excéntrico que podría ayudarte con eso. ...

en: As soon as you got both things, travel to Venore and find the merchant Nurik. Trade the false documents for the famous painting of Mina Losa and bring it to me.
translated: Tan pronto como tengas ambas cosas, viaja a Venore y encuentra al comerciante Nurik. Cambia los documentos falsos por el famoso cuadro de Mina Losa y tráemelo.

en: You might need some of them to get that chest open. The soon to be ex-owner of that vase is Sarina, the proprietor of Carlin's general store.
translated: Es posible que necesites algunos de ellos para abrir ese cofre. La futura ex propietaria de ese jarrón es Sarina, propietaria de la tienda general de Carlin.

en: Your first job is quite easy. The Thaian officials are unwilling to share the wealth they've accumulated in their new town Port Hope. ...
translated: Tu primer trabajo es bastante fácil. Los funcionarios tailandeses no están dispuestos a compartir la riqueza que han acumulado en su nueva ciudad Port Hope. ...

en: Excellent, that serves this fool right. I fear in your next mission, you'll have to get your hands dirty. Just ask me to learn more about it.
translated: Excelente, eso le está bien merecido a este tonto. Me temo que en tu próxima misión tendrás que ensuciarte las manos. Sólo pídeme que aprenda más al respecto.

en: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
translated: ¡Bienvenido, |PLAYERNAME|! ¿Te sientes aventurero? ¿Quiere un {ticket} semanal para el sistema de vagones de mineral aquí? ¡Puedes usarlo aquí mismo para llegar al centro de Kazordoon!

en: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
translated: Orshabaal salió de su laberinto para hacernos sufrir durante muchos días. En Calmera apareció un caballero de barba azul desde su escondite. Luchó valientemente apoyado por magos, el demonio huyó y desapareció por mucho tiempo.

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Un caballero de Guardia necesitaba la llave de Chayenne. Su amigo dejó caer el objeto al suelo, esperando que nadie lo viera. Pero, en el mismo momento, un hombre se cruzó en su camino y todos los sueños del caballero se desvanecieron.

en: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
translated: Orshabaal salió de su laberinto para hacernos sufrir durante muchos días. En Calmera apareció un caballero de barba azul desde su escondite. Luchó valientemente apoyado por magos, el demonio huyó y desapareció por mucho tiempo.

en: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
translated: ¿Crees que es sólo un juego? ¿No temes la llama del dragón? Si eres tan valiente como brillante, si no te desvías de la lucha, quizás quieras escuchar esta noche la historia del caballero solitario de Guardia.

en: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
translated: Un joven hechicero nacido y criado en Astera cuando los dragones daban miedo, era ese tipo de época. Caminando hasta la ciudad de Venore, robó del puente enano nada menos que un mineral de hierro.

en: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
translated: Un caballero de Guardia necesitaba la llave de Chayenne. Su amigo dejó caer el objeto al suelo, esperando que nadie lo viera. Pero, en el mismo momento, un hombre se cruzó en su camino y todos los sueños del caballero se desvanecieron.

en: During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
translated: Durante la noche oscura y aterradora, cuando otros duermen, él va a pelear, desterrando demonios, eso se siente bien, purgando el mal a la vista, esperando sin miedo la luz del día, el caballero de élite más valiente de Zeluna.

en: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
translated: Solo soy un anciano, pero sé mucho sobre Tibia.

en: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
translated: Solo soy un anciano, pero sé mucho sobre Tibia.
Bienvenido a la tienda de muebles Edron, |PLAYERNAME|.

en: Recently, one of our members moved to Liberty Bay out of nowhere, talking about some strange cult. That is not the problem, but he took my favourite crossbow with him. ...
translated: Recientemente, uno de nuestros miembros se mudó a Liberty Bay de la nada, hablando de una secta extraña. Ese no es el problema, pero se llevó mi ballesta favorita. ...

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Soy el líder de los Paladines. Ayudo a nuestros miembros.

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Soy el líder de los Paladines. Ayudo a nuestros miembros.

en: King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
translated: El rey Tibiano es un gobernante sabio.

en: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
translated: Soy el líder de los Paladines. Ayudo a nuestros miembros.

en: Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
translated: Los paladines son grandes guerreros y magos. Además de eso, somos excelentes cazamisiles. Mucha gente en Tibia quiere unirse a nosotros.

en: Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
translated: ¡Los paladines son los mejores luchadores con misiles en Tibia!

en:
I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
translated:
Soy el líder de los Kuridai y los Az'irel de Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Los humanos lo llamarían {sheriff}, verdugo o vengador.

en: Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
translated: La magia druídica es demasiado pacífica para mi gusto.

en: However, recently we lost contact. I don't know what has happened to him and fear the worst ...
translated: Sin embargo, recientemente perdimos el contacto. No sé qué le ha pasado y temo lo peor...

en: My ring was stolen by a parrot, directly from my dressing table near the window. It flew to the nearby mountains and I fear my ring will be lost forever. Whoever returns it to me will be rewarded generously. ...
translated: Un loro me robó el anillo, directamente de mi tocador cerca de la ventana. Voló a las montañas cercanas y temo que mi anillo se pierda para siempre. Quien me lo devuelva será recompensado generosamente. ...

en: Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
translated: Pregunte por Ab'Dendriel. Muchos elfos pueden enseñarte algo sobre magia. Los Cenath aman la magia sobre todo.

en: Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
translated: Bien. Tubería rota y generator pedazos, se escapa humo. Así los reconoces. Mira cómo puedes arreglarlos usando tus manos. Necesitan al menos veinte de ellos reparados. Informe a mí o a Jacob

translated: The Kiss of the Banshee Queen

translated: Paw and Fur - Rank: Big Game Hunter

en: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
translated: Todo es una canción. Vida, muerte, historia... todo. Escuchar el canto de algo es el primer paso para comprenderlo.

en: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
translated: Todo es una canción. Vida, muerte, historia... todo. Escuchar el canto de algo es el primer paso para comprenderlo.

en: And this is where you come into play. Find the ship plans in the Venorean shipyard or perhaps at the harbour and bring them here immediately.
translated: Y aquí es donde entras en juego tú. Encuentra los planos del barco en el astillero de Venorean o quizás en el puerto y tráelos aquí inmediatamente.

en: The scheming Venoreans are a constant thorn in our side. They supply our enemies with all kind of equipment to boost the threat they pose to our freedom. It will be your task to hinder future weapon deliveries significantly ...
translated: Los intrigantes venoreanos son una espina constante en nuestro costado. Proporcionan a nuestros enemigos todo tipo de equipo para aumentar la amenaza que representan para nuestra libertad. Su tarea será obstaculizar significativamente las futuras entregas de armas...

en: A wandering druid has recently visited the Green Claw Swamp, located north west of that corrupted hell hole Venore. While gathering herbs, he noticed some malignant presence in the said area ...
translated: Un druida errante visitó recientemente el Pantano Garra Verde, ubicado al noroeste de ese agujero infernal corrupto Venore. Mientras recogía hierbas, notó alguna presencia maligna en dicha zona...

en: After the druid's return to Carlin, divination confirmed his upsetting assumptions about the existence of these trees ...
translated: Después del regreso del druida a Carlin, la adivinación confirmó sus inquietantes suposiciones sobre la existencia de estos árboles...

en: He has a laboratory somewhere in Kazordoon, probably somewhere near the technomancer hall. Find him and kill him! Bring me his beard as a proof!
translated: Tiene un laboratorio en algún lugar de Kazordoon, probablemente en algún lugar cerca de la sala del tecnomante. ¡Encuéntralo y mátalo! ¡Tráeme su barba como prueba!

en: Our relations with Thais can be called strained at best. Therefore, it's not really astounding that the Thaian financed Edron's academy but refuse to share some knowledge with our druids ..
translated: Nuestras relaciones con Thais pueden considerarse, en el mejor de los casos, tensas. Por lo tanto, no es realmente sorprendente que los tailandeses financiaran la academia de Edron pero se negaran a compartir algunos conocimientos con nuestros druidas.

en: As you might know, once the old aristocracy of our city shared blood-ties with the noblemen of Thais. There are many unresolved claims for titles and family heirlooms and Thais does little to help in this matter ...
translated: Como sabrás, una vez la antigua aristocracia de nuestra ciudad compartió lazos de sangre con los nobles de Thais. Hay muchas reclamaciones sin resolver sobre títulos y reliquias familiares y Thais hace poco para ayudar en este asunto...

en: Ruins of some ancient cathedral are found south west of Venore. It was a project that the Thaians never finished. However, our scouts reported some suspicious activities there ...
translated: Las ruinas de una antigua catedral se encuentran al suroeste de Venore. Fue un proyecto que los tailandeses nunca terminaron. Sin embargo, nuestros exploradores informaron sobre algunas actividades sospechosas allí...

en: Venore has plans for a new kind of ship. It will be faster and more resilient than any other known ship. It will surely improve their dominance over the sea trade. Unless we get those plans for ourselves ...
translated: Venore tiene planes para un nuevo tipo de barco. Será más rápido y resistente que cualquier otro barco conocido. Seguramente mejorará su dominio sobre el comercio marítimo. A menos que consigamos esos planes para nosotros mismos...

en: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
translated: La brigada de chicas es el frente principal en el que luchamos contra los numerosos enemigos de nuestra ciudad... Es una carrera constante para estar por delante de nuestros enemigos. La lealtad absoluta y la voluntad de poner la vida en juego son atributos vitales para esta brigada... ¡Si te unes, dedicas tu servicio solo a Carlin! ¿De verdad crees que eres lo suficientemente chica como para unirte a la brigada?

en: I hope this old book will do those researches any good. Personally I see little use to proof some bloodlines after we cut all ties to Thais.
translated: Espero que este viejo libro sirva de algo para esas investigaciones. Personalmente, veo de poca utilidad probar algunas líneas de sangre después de que cortamos todos los vínculos con Thais.

en: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
translated: La brigada de chicas es el frente principal en el que luchamos contra los numerosos enemigos de nuestra ciudad... Es una carrera constante para estar por delante de nuestros enemigos. La lealtad absoluta y la voluntad de poner la vida en juego son atributos vitales para esta brigada... ¡Si te unes, dedicas tu servicio solo a Carlin! ¿De verdad crees que eres lo suficientemente chica como para unirte a la brigada?

en: Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
translated: Darashia nunca se preocupa por los asuntos de otras ciudades.

en: It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
translated: Es sólo otra marioneta tailandesa. Aún así, está lo suficientemente lejos como para tener una buena oportunidad de deshacerse de la opresión de Thais algún día.

en: The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
translated: Los enanos de Kazordoon generalmente se ocupan de sus propios asuntos. Ojalá todas las demás ciudades hicieran lo mismo.

en: Deixe-me dar uma olhada em voce!
translated: Deixe-me dar uma olhada em voce!

en: Deixe-me dar uma olhada em voce!
translated: Deixe-me dar uma olhada em voce!

en:
The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ... \z
	They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
translated:
Los elfos de Ab'Dendriel son nuestros aliados. Nuestros druidas son los que más contribuyen a mantener tan buena relación. ...\z
	Parecen entender a los elfos un poco mejor que nosotros, la gente corriente.

en:
The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ... \z
	It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
translated:
El nombre de la ciudad es una broma cruel. La gente de allí está oprimida por Thais y Venore que poco a poco desangran la isla y a su gente. ...\z
	Muestra lo que nos habría pasado si nuestra rebelión hubiera fracasado.

en: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
translated: Soy la jefa de la Brigada de Niñas de Carlin, también conocida como CGB.

en: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
translated: Soy la jefa de la Brigada de Niñas de Carlin, también conocida como CGB.

en: Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
translated: Venore es un infierno de maldad. La codicia de los magnates del comercio les permite conspirar contra todas las demás ciudades e incluso entre sí.

en: Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
translated: Svargrond es un proyecto importante para nuestra ciudad. No es una colonia pero mucha de nuestra gente vive allí junto a esos bárbaros. Si todo sale bien, Carlin y Svargrond prosperarán.

en: May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city?
translated: Que el Fuego y la Tierra te bendigan, extraño. ¿Qué te lleva a Beregar, la ciudad de los enanos?

en: Thought so. Could use some help anyway. Listen, I need stuff. Someone gave me a strange assignment - sneak into Thais castle at night and shroud it with cloth without anyone noticing it. ...
translated: Eso pensé. Me vendría bien un poco de ayuda de todos modos. Escucha, necesito cosas. Alguien me dio una tarea extraña: colarme en el castillo Thais por la noche y envolverlo con una tela sin que nadie se diera cuenta. ...

en:
There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, \
		the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. \
		Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
translated:
Hay cinco bendiciones disponibles en cinco lugares sagrados: el escudo {spiritual}, \
		la chispa del {phoenix}, el {embrace} de Tibia, el fuego del {suns} y la sabiduría de {solitude}. \
		Además, puedes recibir el {twist of fate} aquí.

en:
I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by \
		the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
translated:
Puedo sentir que la chispa del fénix ya te la dio \
		los sacerdotes enanos de la tierra y el fuego en Kazordoon.

en: We don't really know how to destroy it but we suppose it may work if you reflect the invisible power of the ball. The beam should be adjusted to Ab'Dendriel. Take this mirror and give it a try. Good luck.
translated: Realmente no sabemos cómo destruirlo, pero suponemos que puede funcionar si reflejas el poder invisible de la pelota. El haz debe ajustarse a Ab'Dendriel. Toma este espejo y pruébalo. Buena suerte.

en: Have you ever heard of Elvenbane? It is the castle west of Ab'Dendriel which is inhabited by villains from all over the continent. Any support in this war is welcome. Are you willing to help?
translated: ¿Alguna vez has oído hablar de Elvenbane? Es el castillo al oeste de Ab'Dendriel que está habitado por villanos de todo el continente. Cualquier apoyo en esta guerra es bienvenido. ¿Estás dispuesto a ayudar?

en: I can teach the spells 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature', and 'summon creature'.
translated: Puedo enseñar los hechizos 'magic shield', 'destroy field', 'creature illusion', 'chameleon', 'convince creature' y 'summon creature'.

en:
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ... \z
	Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
translated:

en: I am an aspiring businessman, who thrives to climb the ladder of success in the Venorean society.

en: I do not fear for his safety because his cover is foolproof, but I cannot contact him either. This is where you come in. ...
translated: No temo por su seguridad porque su tapadera es infalible, pero tampoco puedo contactar con él. Aquí es donde entras tú....

en:
This {plane} is now inhabited by {intruders} and creatures that accidentally became {dragged} in. ... \z

en:
In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ... \z
	Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ... \z
	If only our plan had worked!
translated:
В един справедлив свят бих бил капитан на голям кораб, ... \z
	Онези пирати там сега щяха да бъдат мои слуги и ние щяхме да се борим с моретата и да се превърнем в ужаса на крайбрежните градове! ... \z
	Само ако нашият план беше проработил!

en:
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ... \z
	He said the canoes would do for a while. ... \z
	I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
translated:
Капитан Кид продаде кораба си, за да купи безсмислени неща като онези безумно скъпи ключалки за вратите на килиите. ... \z
	Той каза, че канутата ще свършат работа за известно време. ... \z
	Останах с впечатлението, че не беше много тъжен да се раздели с кораба, защото беше известно, че страда много от морска болест.

en:
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ... \z
	Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
translated:
Щях да бъда много по-добър капитан от Хлапето. Играх няколко капитана на сцената и бях добър! ... \z
	Където Кид копнееше за признателността на хората си, аз щях да управлявам от страх и с железен юмрук!

en:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
translated:
Всичко беше идея на капитан Кид. Виждате ли, той мразеше името си и планираше да стане известен с името капитан Киднап. ... \z
	Всичко, от което се нуждаеше, беше някой известен, когото да отвлече. ... \z
	Като се има предвид ужасната липса на талант и интелигентност на хората му, това би било голямо постижение. ... \z
	Познавахме се от няколко измами, които направихме заедно в миналото, така че той се свърза с мен. ... \z
	Трябваше да се превъплътя в прочутата принцеса Лумелия. Знаеш ли, този, който всички търсеха. ... \z
	Това щеше да покаже на неговите хора и на другите пирати какъв страхотен похитител беше той. ... \z
	Той ми обеща, че ще стана негов втори командващ и ще водя прекрасен живот на грабежи, грабежи и грабежи. ... \z
	Затова се съгласих да се представя за принцесата за известно време и в началото работи добре. ... \z
	Той се завърна с мен, облечен като принцесата от нападение сам и моментално стана героят на деня за своите хора. ... \z
	Нещата се влошиха, когато решиха да направят парти за победа. ... \z
	Доколкото успях да разбера от мърморенето на пиратите, Кид изгуби ключа от килията ми, докато се облекчаваше в подземната река. ... \z
	Глупакът реши да се гмурне след него .. за да не бъде видян никога повече. ... \z
	Когато разбрах за гибелта на Кид, се опитах да убедя пиратите, че това е измама, но те просто не ми повярваха!

en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
translated:
Ах, отвличането е толкова забавно. Това е, ако не сте от приемащата страна. ... \z
	Това са лесни пари и имате шанс да изплашите и измъчите някой, който не може да отвърне на удара!

en:
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ... \z
	And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ... \z
	So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
translated:
Колкото по-глупави са хората, толкова по-лесно е да ги измамите. ... \z
	И колкото по-бедни са те, толкова по-малко средства имат да си отмъстят. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Така че се уверявам, че съсипвам тези, които измамя. Тогава те имат други неща, за които да се тревожат, освен да ми отмъстят.

en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
translated:
Ключът е изгубен в подземната река и вероятно вече е отнесен в седемте морета! ... \z
	Ако това глупаво Хлапе не беше толкова обсебено от отвличането, нямаше да продаде кораба си, за да купи най-скъпите и сложни брави за клетките си!

en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
translated:
Докато се придържаме към незащитените крайбрежни градове, можем лесно да направим състояние. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Веднага щом изляза оттук, най-накрая сам ще стана пиратски капитан. Не ми трябва Капитан Кид!

en: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...

translated: Algunos viajeros de Edron hablaron de un gran tesoro custodiado por crueles demonios en las mazmorras de allí.

en: From all we know the lamp is still in the Orc King's possession! Therefore I want to ask you to enter thewell guarded halls over at Ulderek's Rock and find the lamp. ...
translated: ¡Por lo que sabemos, la lámpara todavía está en posesión del Rey Orco! Por lo tanto, quiero pedirte que entres en los pasillos bien vigilados de la Roca de Ulderek y encuentres la lámpara. ...

en: What's left to do now is seek out Merikh the Slaughterer, an especially cruel Efreet. He hides somewhere in Yalahar. I don't know if you can kill him, but you should at least try.
translated: Lo que queda por hacer ahora es buscar a Merikh el Matador, un Efreet especialmente cruel. Se esconde en algún lugar de Yalahar. No sé si podrás matarlo, pero al menos deberías intentarlo.

en: I always feared that I lost her. And yet, all those years, I still had a gleam of hope. I'm devastated to learn about her fate - but at least I have certainty now. Thank you for telling me.
translated: Siempre temí perderla. Y, sin embargo, durante todos esos años, todavía tenía un rayo de esperanza. Estoy devastada al enterarme de su destino, pero al menos ahora tengo la certeza. Gracias por decírmelo.

translated: Una vez que hayas alcanzado el nivel 8, estarás listo para elegir una vocación e ir al continente Tibiano.

translated: Los hechizos aquí en Dawnport son sólo para probar, y los olvidarás una vez que elijas tu vocación definitiva y te vayas al continente. ...

en: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.

Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
translated:
Oh, no está tan mal aquí, créeme. ¡Al menos siempre consigo discípulos jóvenes y entusiastas! \z
		Aunque debo confesar que extraño la inmensidad de las llanuras tibianas. <sighs>

en: Welcome to the wonderful and only recently opened Museum of Tibian Arts! Free entrance for everybody, but patrons of the arts are wanted and favoured.
translated: ¡Bienvenido al maravilloso y recientemente inaugurado Museo de Artes Tibias! Entrada gratuita para todos, pero se busca y favorece a los mecenas de las artes.

en: The Druid of Crunor has sent you? He seems to know that this new museum shines like a diamond. Enjoy your stay! If you like to {support} this place, talk to me.
translated: ¿El Druid de Crunor te ha enviado? Parece saber que este nuevo museo brilla como un diamante. ¡Disfruta de tu estancia! Si te gusta {support} este lugar, habla conmigo.

en: Astonishingly, Dedoras from Cormaya has recently asked me for these kinds of inscriptions. For sure he is able to bring light into the darkness. You should visit him.
translated: Sorprendentemente, Dedoras de Cormaya me ha pedido recientemente este tipo de inscripciones. Seguro que es capaz de traer luz a la oscuridad. Deberías visitarlo.

en: They want us to buy the picture back. Unfortunately this artefact is so important that I don't see an alternative. Please got to Iwar in Kazordoon and pay the money.
translated: Quieren que volvamos a comprar el cuadro. Lamentablemente este artefacto es tan importante que no veo otra alternativa. Llegue a Iwar en Kazordoon y pague el dinero.

en: Third: Which ancient Tibian race reportedly travelled the sky in cloud ships? Can you answer these questions?
translated: Tercero: ¿Qué antigua raza tibiana supuestamente viajó por el cielo en naves de nubes? ¿Puedes responder estas preguntas?

en: That's right. Listen to the third question: Which ancient Tibian race reportedly travelled the sky in cloud ships?
translated: Así es. Escuche la tercera pregunta: ¿Qué antigua raza tibiana supuestamente viajó por el cielo en naves de nubes?

en: So the leader of these... Misguided was actually controlled and not the other way round? Whatever is behind all this, that's some first-rate irony right there.
translated: Entonces, ¿el líder de estos... Misguided estaba realmente controlado y no al revés? Lo que sea que esté detrás de todo esto, hay una ironía de primer nivel.

en: There's a camp of outlaws to the east of Thais. Rumour has it that people are going missing but it's not linked to the bandits. ...
translated: Hay un campamento de forajidos al este de Thais. Se rumorea que hay personas desaparecidas, pero no está relacionado con los bandidos. ...

en: Lights have been seen at night in the abandoned ruin in the vicinity of the camp, somewhere to the south-west. Brave enough to check it out?
translated: Se han visto luces por la noche en las ruinas abandonadas en las cercanías del campamento, en algún lugar al suroeste. ¿Lo suficientemente valiente como para comprobarlo?

en: Several Edron orcs have taken to a dangerous idol it seems. It may not be too late to stop them if you act quickly. A powerful cult of orcs with a broad following could prove unsurmountable in the end. ...
translated: Al parecer, varios orcos Edron se han aficionado a un ídolo peligroso. Puede que no sea demasiado tarde para detenerlos si actúa con rapidez. Un poderoso culto de orcos con un amplio número de seguidores podría resultar insuperable al final. ...

en: The alleged incentive to follow this cult is infinite prosperity. Therefore most of the worshippers are already very rich citizens of Tibia. ...
translated: El supuesto incentivo para seguir este culto es la prosperidad infinita. Por lo tanto, la mayoría de los fieles ya son ciudadanos muy ricos de Tibia. ...

en: This cult is abandoned in the recently opened new museum in Thais. This can be entered in the Thais exhibition. Would you like to have a look at this cult?
translated: Este culto está abandonado en el nuevo museo recientemente inaugurado en Thais. Esto se puede inscribir en la exposición Thais. ¿Le gustaría echar un vistazo a este culto?

In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ... \z
	Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ... \z
	If only our plan had worked!
translated:
Во праведен свет, јас би бил капетан на голем брод, ... \z
	Тие пирати таму сега би биле мои потчинети, а ние би се храбреле на морињата и би станале теророт на крајбрежните градови! ... \z
	Да успееше нашиот план!

en:
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ... \z
	He said the canoes would do for a while. ... \z
	I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
translated:
Капетанот Кид го продаде својот брод за да купи бесмислени работи како оние лудо скапи брави за вратите на ќелијата. ... \z
	Тој рече дека кануата ќе прават некое време. ... \z
	Добив впечаток дека не беше премногу тажен што се раздели со бродот бидејќи беше познато дека многу страдаше од морска болест.

en:
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ... \z
	Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
translated:
Ќе бев многу подобар капитен од Кид. Играв неколку капетани на сцената и бев добар! ... \z
	Онаму каде што Кид копнееше за ценење на неговите луѓе, јас би владеел со страв и со железна тупаница!

en:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
translated:
Сето тоа беше идеја на капетанот Кид. Гледате, тој го мразеше своето име и планираше да стане познат по името капетан Киднап. ... \z
	Сè што му требаше беше некој познат да киднапира. ... \z
	Со оглед на лош недостиг на талент и интелигенција на неговите луѓе, тоа би било голем подвиг. ... \z
	Се познававме по неколку измами што ги направивме заедно во минатото, па тој ме контактираше. ... \z
	Требаше да ја имитирам познатата принцеза Лумелија. Знаете, оној кој сите го бараа. ... \z
	Тоа ќе им покаже на неговите луѓе и на другите пирати каков голем киднапер бил. ... \z
	Ми вети дека ќе му станам втор човек и ќе водам прекрасен живот на грабеж, грабеж и грабеж. ... \z
	Така, се согласив да ја имитирам принцезата некое време и тоа на почетокот функционираше добро. ... \z
	Тој се врати со мене облечен како принцезата од рација сам и веднаш беше херој на денот за своите луѓе. ... \z
	Работите тргнаа на лошо кога решија да направат победничка забава. ... \z
	Колку што можев да забележам од мрморењето на пиратите, Кид го изгуби клучот од мојата ќелија додека се олеснуваше во подземната река. ... \z
	Будалата реши да се нурне по неа.. никогаш повеќе да не се види. ... \z
	Кога дознав за смртта на Кид, се обидов да ги убедам пиратите дека тоа е измама, но тие едноставно нема да ми веруваат!

en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
translated:
Ах, киднапирањето е многу забавно. Тоа е, ако не сте на примачот. ... \z
	Лесни се парите и имаш шанса да исплашиш и измачуваш некој што не може да возврати!

en:
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ... \z
	And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ... \z
	So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
translated:
Колку луѓето се поглупави, толку е полесно да се измамат. ... \z
	И колку се посиромашни толку помалку средства имаат да се одмаздат. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Затоа се погрижувам да ги уништам оние што ги измамувам. Тогаш тие имаат други работи за кои треба да се грижат освен да ми се одмаздат.

en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
translated:
Клучот е изгубен во подземната река и веројатно до сега се фрлил во седумте мориња! ... \z
	Ако тоа глупаво Дете не беше толку опседнато со киднапирање, немаше да го продаде својот брод за да ги купи најскапите и најкомплицираните брави за неговите ќелии!

en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
translated:
Сè додека се држиме до небранетите крајбрежни градови, можеме лесно да се збогатиме. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Штом ќе излезам одовде, конечно сам ќе станам пиратски капетан. Не ми треба капетан Кид!

en: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.

Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
translated:
Oh, no está tan mal aquí, créeme. ¡Al menos siempre consigo discípulos jóvenes y entusiastas! \z
		Aunque debo confesar que extraño la inmensidad de las llanuras tibianas. <sighs>

en:
Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ... \z
	Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ... \z
	Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
translated:
Los faunos son espíritus de la naturaleza mitad humanos, mitad bestias que habitan los bosques y montañas de Feyrist. Son un pueblo un poco pícaro pero alegre, amantes del vino y del baile. ...\z
	Los faunos muestran un aspecto juvenil y gracioso pero también son valientes e intrépidos a la hora de defenderse. Como me dijo Maelyrra, surgen de los sueños de los mortales sobre celebraciones, música y baile. ...\z
	Últimamente, algunos faunos de Feyrist están contaminados por la fuerza misteriosa y siniestra que amenaza a Feyrist y al resto de Tibia.

en:
Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ... \z
	Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ... \z
	They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
translated:
Los duendes son pequeños espíritus de la naturaleza y criaturas míticas que habitan los bosques y llanuras de Feyrist. Generalmente son benignos, pero a veces también pueden mostrar rasgos traviesos. ...\z
	Como a la mayoría de las hadas, a los duendes les encanta bailar y a menudo se reúnen en grupos más grandes para bailar en claros apartados. A los duendes les encantan las flores, las mariposas, los escarabajos relucientes, las gemas y otras cosas coloridas. ...\z
	También les encanta el sabor de la miel, la avena endulzada y las uvas maduras. Como me dijo Maelyrra, los duendes surgen de los sueños de los mortales sobre amigos y familiares.

en:
Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ... \z
	Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. ... \z
	Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
translated:
Los pookas son espíritus de la naturaleza en forma animal, que parecen grandes liebres con un pelaje ligeramente brillante. Son benignos pero traviesos, sin duda, con razón, considerados los embaucadores entre las hadas. ...\z
	A los Pookas les encanta gastar bromas a los demás, delatar y esconder cosas o contar historias inventadas. Son criaturas caprichosas y volubles. Los pookas surgen de los sueños de los mortales sobre gemas, tesoros y oro. ...\z
	Últimamente, algunos pookas de Feyrist están contaminados por una fuerza misteriosa y siniestra que amenaza a Feyrist y al resto de Tibia.

en:
Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ... \z
	Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ... \z
	They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
translated:
Las doncellas cisne son hadas que pueden cambiar de forma humana a forma de cisne. El objeto mágico que permite esta transformación es una capa de plumas de cisne, una prenda con plumas de cisne adheridas. ...\z
	Aquí en Feyrist siempre es difícil saber si un cisne nadando en un lago es un animal normal o una doncella cisne con forma de pájaro. ...\z
	Protegen las tierras salvajes de su reino secreto de cualquier intruso y viven en pequeñas bandadas a lo largo de las apartadas orillas de los lagos. Como me dijo Maelyrra, las doncellas cisne surgen de los sueños de los mortales sobre volar.

en:
Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ... \z
	They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
translated:
Las ninfas son espíritus femeninos de la naturaleza y normalmente toman la forma de hermosas y jóvenes doncellas a las que les encanta bailar y cantar. Habitan en las colinas y bosques de Feyrist, a menudo cerca de lagos y arroyos y no pueden morir de vejez ni de enfermedad. ...\z
	Tienen un vínculo especial y fuerte con las plantas y animales de su dominio y son muy protectores de la flora y fauna de Feyrist. Como me dijo Maelyrra, las ninfas surgen de los sueños de amor de los mortales.

en:
Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ... \z
	Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are now twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
translated:
Los boogies son un tipo de hadas bastante retorcido. Además de los duendes, las ninfas o los faunos, prefieren las cuevas y túneles subterráneos a los bosques o praderas exuberantes. ...\z
	Sólo de noche deambulan por la superficie, persiguiendo a otras hadas y visitantes de Feyrist por igual. Alguna vez fueron hadas torpes pero pacíficas, pero ahora están retorcidas y contaminadas por una fuerza misteriosa y siniestra.

en:
She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ... \z
	I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.
translated:
Ella es la reina de una corte de hadas. Puedes encontrarla en un claro en lo profundo del bosque. Fue la reina Maelyrra quien me concedió permiso para quedarme aquí en Feyrist. ...\z
	Prometí informarle sobre cualquier cosa que descubra sobre la fuerza abominable que amenaza este mundo.

en:
We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ... \z
	that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are not meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this knowledge ... \z
	And ultimately not only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it knowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ... \z
	In some way their tainted knowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ... \z
	That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
translated:
No hemos descubierto completamente cuál es exactamente nuestro enemigo. Por un lado, esta cosa desafía todas las leyes de la naturaleza y la comprensión,... \z
	que comprenderlo es imposible o torcer la mente de maneras que no deberían ser. También los Yalahari que descubrieron demasiado sobre el asunto, quedaron contaminados y cambiados por este conocimiento... \z
	Y finalmente no sólo cayeron y se convirtieron en suyos, sino que también dotaron a la cosa de algo propio, ya sea conocimiento, comprensión o incluso dirección, propósito. ...\z
	De alguna manera, su conocimiento contaminado hizo que lo impensable se pareciera a la existencia. ...\z
	Es por eso que no podemos incursionar demasiado en resolver esto y más bien concentrarnos en nuestra lucha para cortar sus vínculos con nuestro mundo.

en: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Where do you want me to {fly} you? Or do you need a weekly ticket for the Kazordoon public lorry transport?
translated: Saludos viajero |PLAYERNAME|. ¿Dónde quieres que te {fly}? ¿O necesita un billete semanal para el transporte público de camiones Kazordoon?

en: This was once the centre of power of our religion. From here we ruled Tiquanda in the name of the snake god.
translated: Este fue una vez el centro de poder de nuestra religión. Desde aquí gobernamos Tiquanda en nombre del dios serpiente.

en: What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
translated: Lo que llamas Banuta alguna vez fue el centro de nuestra civilización y cultura. Les dimos mucho a esos {apes}, pero querían más. Al final, el Gran {Snake} los utilizó como herramienta para enseñarle a nuestro pueblo una lección dolorosa pero necesaria.

en: Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.
translated: Dragons son una de las mayores creaciones del Gran {Snake}. Sin embargo, todavía están distanciados del Gran {Snake} y susceptibles a {corruption} y las mentiras de los ladrones de huevos.

	If only our plan had worked!
translated:
У справедливому світі я був би капітаном великого корабля, ... \z
	Ті пірати тепер стали б моїми прихильниками, а ми б сміливо вилазили на моря й ставали жахом прибережних міст! ... \z
	Якби наш план спрацював!

en:
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ... \z
	He said the canoes would do for a while. ... \z
	I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
translated:
Капітан Кід продав свій корабель, щоб купити безглузді речі, як ці шалено дорогі замки для дверей камери. ... \z
	Він сказав, що каное підійде на деякий час. ... \z
	У мене склалося враження, що він не надто сумував розлучатися з кораблем, оскільки, як відомо, він часто страждає від морської хвороби.

en:
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ... \z
	Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
translated:
Я був би набагато кращим капітаном, ніж Кід. Я зіграв кількох капітанів на сцені, і мені вийшло добре! ... \z
	Там, де Кід прагнув оцінки своїх людей, я правив би страхом і залізною рукою!

en:
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ... \z
	All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ... \z
	Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ... \z
	We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ... \z
	I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ... \z
	That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ... \z
	He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ... \z
	So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ... \z
	He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ... \z
	Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ... \z
	As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ... \z
	The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ... \z
	When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
translated:
Усе це була ідея капітана Кіда. Розумієте, він ненавидів своє ім'я і планував стати відомим під іменем капітана Кіднапа. ... \z
	Йому потрібен був лише хтось відомий, кого можна викрасти. ... \z
	Враховуючи жалюгідну відсутність таланту та інтелекту у його людей, це було б справжнім подвигом. ... \z
	Ми були знайомі з кількома шахраями, які робили разом у минулому, тому він зв’язався зі мною. ... \z
	Я мала втілити знамениту принцесу Лумелію. Знаєш, ту, яку всі шукали. ... \z
	Це показало б його людям та іншим піратам, яким він був чудовим викрадачем. ... \z
	Він пообіцяв мені, що я стану його другим командиром і буду жити чудовим життям, грабуючи, грабуючи та грабуючи. ... \z
	Тож я погодився на деякий час уособлювати Принцесу, і спочатку це працювало добре. ... \z
	Він повернувся зі мною в костюмі Принцеси з самостійного рейду і миттєво став героєм дня для своїх людей. ... \z
	Справи пішли погано, коли вони вирішили влаштувати свято перемоги. ... \z
	Наскільки я міг зрозуміти з бурмотіння піратів, Малюк загубив ключ від моєї камери, коли справляв нужду в підземній річці. ... \z
	Дурень вирішив пірнути за ним .. щоб ніколи більше його не побачити. ... \z
	Коли я дізнався про загибель Кіда, я намагався переконати піратів, що це обман, але вони мені просто не повірили!

en:
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ... \z
	It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
translated:
Ах, викрадення - це так весело. Тобто, якщо ви не на одержувачі. ... \z
	Це легкі гроші, і у вас є шанс налякати і мучити того, хто не може дати відсіч!

en:
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ... \z
	And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ... \z
	So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
translated:
Чим дурніші люди, тим легше їх обдурити. ... \z
	І чим вони бідніші, тим менше у них засобів помститися. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Тому я обов’язково знищу тих, кого обманюю. Тоді їм є про що турбуватися, крім того, щоб помститися мені.

en:
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ... \z
	If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
translated:
Ключ був втрачений у підземній річці і, мабуть, уже змитий сімома морями! ... \z
	Якби цей дурний Хлопець не був так одержимий викраденням, він би не продав свій корабель, щоб купити найдорожчі та найскладніші замки для своїх камер!

en:
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ... \z
	As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
translated:
Поки ми будемо триматися незахищених прибережних міст, ми можемо легко розбагатіти. Хар Хар! ... \z
	Як тільки я вийду звідси, я нарешті сам стану піратським капітаном. Мені не потрібен Капітан Кід!

en: Superb work. However, there is something else I want you to do. It is said that there is a quara general named 'Thul' who is responsible for the attacks on Liberty Bay. Find and kill the general and bring peace back to Liberty Bay! ...
translated: Excelente trabajo. Sin embargo, hay algo más que quiero que hagas. Se dice que hay un quara general llamado 'Thul' que es el responsable de los ataques a Liberty Bay. ¡Encuentra y mata al general y devuelve la paz a Liberty Bay! ...

en: Nicely done. However, there is something else I want you to do. I have heard that there is a stampor the hunters in the Muggy Plains call 'Tromphonyte'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
translated: Bien hecho. Sin embargo, hay algo más que quiero que hagas. He oído que hay un sello o los cazadores en el Muggy Plains llaman 'Tromphonyte'. ¡Es un ejemplo extremadamente peligroso en su tipo! ...

en: Spiffing work, old chap. Now I have a special task for you. Recently several citizens of Port Hope vanished. It is rumoured that they were killed by a crocodile. The people call it 'Snapper'. Hunt down and kill that evil man-eating beast. ...
translated: Buen trabajo, viejo. Ahora tengo una tarea especial para ti. Recientemente varios ciudadanos de Port Hope desaparecieron. Se rumorea que fueron asesinados por un cocodrilo. La gente lo llama 'Snapper'. Caza y mata a esa malvada bestia devoradora de hombres. ...

en: My - you can be proud of yourself! However, you're not finished yet. There are rumours about a being called 'The Noxious Spawn' which was seen deep down in the ruins of Banuta. Try to find its hideout. ...
translated: ¡Puedes estar orgulloso de ti mismo! Sin embargo, aún no has terminado. Hay rumores sobre un ser llamado 'The Noxious Spawn' que fue visto en lo profundo de las ruinas de Banuta. Intenta encontrar su escondite. ...

en: It's the oldest and most dangerous of all behemoths and was last seen under the Cyclopolis in Edron. What do you think? Are you hunter enough? I think you are!
translated: Es el gigante más antiguo y peligroso de todos y fue visto por última vez bajo el Cyclopolis en Edron. ¿Qué opinas? ¿Eres lo suficientemente cazador? ¡Creo que lo eres!

en: Jolly good job you did there, but now I have a special task for you. The citizens of Svargrond live in fear because of a frightfully bad-tempered mammoth they call 'Blood Tusk'. Go there and put an end to him. Happy hunting!
translated: Muy buen trabajo que hiciste allí, pero ahora tengo una tarea especial para ti. Los ciudadanos de Svargrond viven con miedo a causa de un mamut espantosamente malhumorado al que llaman 'Blood Tusk'. Ve allí y acaba con él. ¡Feliz caza!

en: As I see it, you need more of a challenge! I have heard that there is an ice golem the hunters in Svargrond call 'Shardhead'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
translated: A mi modo de ver, ¡necesitas más desafíos! He oído que hay un golem de hielo que los cazadores en Svargrond llaman 'Shardhead'. ¡Es un ejemplo extremadamente peligroso en su tipo! ...

en: The Yalaharians are having a spot of bother with a huge mutated rat. They call it 'Esmeralda' and you should find her somewhere in the sewers. Good hunting!
translated: Los yalaharianos están teniendo un problema con una enorme rata mutada. Lo llaman 'Esmeralda' y deberías encontrarla en algún lugar de las alcantarillas. ¡Buena caza!

en: The people of Ankrahmun are having a spot of bother with a huge ancient scarab. They call it 'Fleshcrawler' and you should find and kill it. Good hunting! ...
translated: La gente de Ankrahmun está teniendo problemas con un enorme escarabajo antiguo. Lo llaman 'Fleshcrawler' y debes encontrarlo y matarlo. ¡Buena caza! ...
